title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 4 mm solid nodule in the left lower lobe. In this low-risk patient no routine follow-up is recommended (Fleischner 2017). Otherwise normal chest CT.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid <6 mm in a low-risk patient needs no routine follow-up.

title: CT chest with contrast
text:
FINDINGS: Solitary 5 mm solid nodule in the RML. Mild centrilobular emphysema. No lymphadenopathy.
IMPRESSION: 5 mm RML nodule. Emphysema.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid <6 mm even in a high-risk patient carries only an optional 12-month CT, not a required follow-up.

title: CTA chest (PE protocol)
text:
IMPRESSION:
1. No pulmonary embolism.
2. Incidental 9 mm solid nodule in the left upper lobe. Recommend follow-up chest CT in 3 months; PET/CT or tissue sampling are alternatives.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid >8 mm -> CT at 3 months, PET/CT or sampling regardless of risk; explicit CT recommendation.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: 우상엽에 6 mm 고형 결절. 12개월 후 추적 CT 권고.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: 6-8 mm solid nodule -> CT at 6-12 months; report recommends 12-month CT.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple bilateral solid pulmonary nodules, the largest 7 mm in the RLL. Differential includes infectious/inflammatory etiology. Recommend follow-up CT in 3-6 months.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: multiple solid nodules 6-8 mm -> CT at 3-6 months.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Densely calcified 8 mm granuloma in the RUL. No suspicious pulmonary nodule.
rationale: Diffusely calcified nodule is benign; Fleischner follow-up not required.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 6 mm triangular nodule abutting the right minor fissure, typical of an intrapulmonary lymph node (perifissural nodule). No follow-up needed.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: typical perifissural nodules need no follow-up even when >6 mm.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: The previously described 7 mm RUL solid nodule is unchanged since CT of 03/2024 (more than 2 years of stability), consistent with a benign etiology. No further follow-up.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid nodule stable for 2 years needs no further follow-up.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: RLL solid nodule now measures 11 mm, increased from 7 mm on 09/2025. Findings are concerning for malignancy. Recommend PET/CT and pulmonology referral.
rationale: Growing solid nodule (>=2 mm growth) is suspicious and needs PET/CT, sampling or referral.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: 좌상엽 부분고형 결절 18 mm, 고형 성분 8 mm로 6개월 전 CT와 비교하여 지속됨. 악성 가능성 배제 못함. PET-CT 및 조직검사 고려 바랍니다.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: persistent part-solid nodule with solid component >=6 mm is highly suspicious -> work-up; R036 not applied to lung nodules.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Single 8 mm pure ground-glass nodule in the LUL. Recommend CT in 6-12 months to confirm persistence.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: ground-glass nodule >=6 mm -> CT at 6-12 months to confirm persistence.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 5 mm ground-glass opacity in the RUL. Per Fleischner, no routine follow-up for a solitary GGN <6 mm.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solitary pure GGN <6 mm needs no routine follow-up.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Part-solid nodule in the RLL measuring 9 mm with a 3 mm solid component. Recommend follow-up CT in 3-6 months to assess persistence.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: part-solid >=6 mm -> CT at 3-6 months.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text:
IMPRESSION:
1. No acute abdominal or pelvic process.
2. Incidental 7 mm solid nodule at the partially imaged left lung base.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: 6-8 mm solid nodule needs CT at 6-12 months at any risk level, even without a stated recommendation.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Solitary 7 mm solid nodule in the RML. Given young age this is likely benign; nevertheless a follow-up CT in 12 months is suggested.
rationale: Fleischner does not apply under 35 years (human review); the explicit radiologist CT recommendation still opens.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Two new solid nodules in the right lower lobe (5 mm and 6 mm), suspicious for metastases in this patient with colon cancer. Recommend short-interval chest CT in 3 months.
rationale: Fleischner excludes patients with known cancer; the explicit 3-month CT recommendation opens.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple scattered nodules with surrounding ground-glass halo in both lungs in this renal transplant recipient, concerning for fungal infection. Recommend bronchoscopy with BAL correlation and follow-up CT after 4-6 weeks of therapy.
rationale: Fleischner excludes immunocompromised patients; explicit follow-up CT recommendation opens.

title: CT chest without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 6 mm RUL solid nodule is stable compared with CT from 7 months ago. In this high-risk patient, recommend follow-up CT at 18-24 months from initial detection.
rationale: Fleischner 2017 high risk 6-8 mm: CT at 6-12 months, then CT at 18-24 months (stepped follow-up).

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No pulmonary nodule or mass. Mild centrilobular emphysema. No pleural effusion.
rationale: Negated finding; nothing to follow.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Previously noted 10 mm RLL nodule has resolved, consistent with an inflammatory etiology. No new nodules.
rationale: Resolved nodule; no follow-up required.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 2 - benign appearance or behavior. 5 mm solid nodule in the RUL. Continue annual screening.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022 category 2: continue routine annual screening; no interval follow-up obligation.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text:
Baseline screening.
IMPRESSION: 7 mm solid nodule in the RLL. Lung-RADS 3, probably benign. Recommend 6-month LDCT.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 6 to <8 mm = category 3 -> 6-month LDCT.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text: 기저 검진. 좌상엽 9 mm 고형 결절. Lung-RADS 4A. 3개월 후 저선량 CT 권고.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 8 to <15 mm = 4A -> 3-month LDCT.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (annual)
text: IMPRESSION: RLL solid nodule increased from 8 mm to 16 mm since prior annual screen. Lung-RADS 4B. Recommend PET/CT and pulmonology referral for tissue sampling.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: growing solid nodule >=8 mm = 4B -> diagnostic work-up; Lung-RADS governs screening nodules.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening
text: IMPRESSION: 12 mm part-solid nodule with spiculated margins in the LUL. Lung-RADS 4X.
rationale: Lung-RADS 4X requires diagnostic work-up (CT, PET/CT, sampling or referral).

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT
text: Lung-RADS 1. 폐결절 없음. 1년 후 정기 검진.
rationale: Lung-RADS 1: continue annual screening only.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text: IMPRESSION: Baseline study. 10 mm part-solid nodule in the RUL with a 3 mm solid component. Lung-RADS 3.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline part-solid >=6 mm with solid component <6 mm = category 3.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (6개월 추적)
text: 6개월 추적 LDCT: 이전 Lung-RADS 3 결절 (우중엽 7 mm) 변화 없음. Lung-RADS 2로 하향 조정. 12개월 후 연례 검진.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: category 3 nodule stable at 6 months is downgraded to 2 -> annual screening only.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (3-month follow-up)
text: IMPRESSION: Previously 10 mm LLL nodule (Lung-RADS 4A) has decreased to 6 mm with ill-defined margins, likely inflammatory. Lung-RADS 2. Resume annual screening.
rationale: Decreasing nodule recategorised Lung-RADS 2: return to annual screening.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (annual)
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 4A. New 7 mm solid nodule in the RML, not present on prior annual screen.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: new solid 6 to <8 mm = 4A -> 3-month LDCT.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: Lung-RADS 4B. 좌하엽 22 mm 분엽상 고형 결절. PET-CT 및 조직검사 권고.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid >=15 mm = 4B -> work-up; R036 not applied under Lung-RADS.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: 기저 검사. 우하엽 6 mm 고형결절. Lung-RADS 3.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 6 to <8 mm = category 3 -> 6-month LDCT.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (baseline)
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 4A: 11 mm solid nodule in the LUL at baseline. Recommend 3-month LDCT.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid 8 to <15 mm = 4A.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: 기저 검진. 우상엽 부분고형 결절 14 mm, 고형 성분 6 mm. Lung-RADS 4A.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: part-solid with solid component 6 to <8 mm at baseline = 4A.

title: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening (annual)
text: IMPRESSION: Lung-RADS 4B. New 9 mm solid nodule in the LLL. Recommend PET/CT; consider tissue sampling.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: new solid nodule >=8 mm = 4B.

title: 저선량 폐암 검진 CT (기저)
text: 기저 검사. 좌상엽 순수 간유리 결절 32 mm. Lung-RADS 3. 6개월 후 저선량 CT 권고.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline GGN >=30 mm = category 3.

title: Diagnostic mammogram and breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 1.1 cm irregular hypoechoic mass with indistinct margins at 10 o'clock, 4 cm FN, left breast. BI-RADS 4B: moderate suspicion for malignancy. Ultrasound-guided core biopsy is recommended.
rationale: BI-RADS 4 requires tissue diagnosis; R036 not applied when BI-RADS governs.

title: Screening mammogram
text: IMPRESSION: No mammographic evidence of malignancy. BI-RADS 1: Negative. Routine annual screening.
rationale: BI-RADS 1: routine screening only.

title: 유방 초음파
text: 우측 유방 2시 방향, 유두로부터 3 cm에 1.4 cm 크기의 불규칙한 저에코 종괴, 후방음영 동반. BI-RADS 5. 조직검사 권고.
rationale: BI-RADS 5 requires biopsy.

title: Breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 0.8 cm oval circumscribed parallel hypoechoic mass at 3 o'clock right breast, probably fibroadenoma. BI-RADS 3: Probably benign. Recommend follow-up ultrasound in 6 months.
rationale: BI-RADS 3: short-interval (6-month) follow-up; explicit ultrasound recommendation.

title: 진단 유방촬영술
text: 좌측 유방 상외측에 segmental 분포의 fine pleomorphic 미세석회화. BI-RADS 4C. 정위 생검 권고.
rationale: BI-RADS 4C requires tissue diagnosis.

title: Diagnostic mammogram
text: IMPRESSION: Known biopsy-proven malignancy in the right breast, preoperative extent evaluation. No additional suspicious findings in either breast. BI-RADS 6.
rationale: BI-RADS 6: malignancy already proven; no new biopsy obligation.

title: Breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 1.2 cm simple cyst at 7 o'clock left breast. BI-RADS 2: Benign.
rationale: Simple cyst, BI-RADS 2: no follow-up.

title: Screening mammogram
text: IMPRESSION: New 8 mm spiculated mass with associated architectural distortion in the right breast upper outer quadrant. BI-RADS 5: highly suggestive of malignancy. Recommend biopsy.
rationale: BI-RADS 5 requires biopsy.

title: Breast ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: 9 mm circumscribed but microlobulated hypoechoic mass at 1 o'clock right breast, not seen on prior. BI-RADS 4A: low suspicion. US-guided biopsy recommended.
rationale: BI-RADS 4A still requires tissue diagnosis.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Left lobe 1.6 cm solid, markedly hypoechoic nodule with irregular margins and punctate echogenic foci. ACR TI-RADS TR5 (10 points). FNA recommended.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR5 >=1.0 cm -> FNA.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text: 우엽 1.2 cm 등에코 고형 결절, TI-RADS TR4. 세침흡인 기준(1.5 cm) 미달로 1년 후 초음파 추적 권고.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR4 1.0-1.4 cm -> follow-up US (1 year).

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple spongiform nodules bilaterally, largest 2.2 cm in the right lobe. TI-RADS TR1. No FNA or follow-up required.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS TR1: no FNA, no follow-up.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Right lobe 2.8 cm mixed cystic and solid isoechoic nodule, TI-RADS TR3. Meets size criteria for FNA (>=2.5 cm).
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR3 >=2.5 cm -> FNA.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text: 좌엽 0.7 cm 고형 저에코 결절, 미세석회화 동반, TI-RADS TR5. 1년 후 추적 초음파 권고.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR5 0.5-0.9 cm -> annual follow-up US.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text: 좌엽 1.7 cm 저에코 고형 결절, 경계 평활, 종횡비 정상. TI-RADS TR4 (5점). 세침흡인검사 권고.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR4 >=1.5 cm -> FNA.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Previously biopsied right 1.8 cm nodule (Bethesda II, 2024) is stable in size and appearance. TR3. No further FNA or imaging follow-up required.
rationale: Nodule already worked up with benign cytology; radiologist states no further follow-up.

title: CT neck with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No cervical lymphadenopathy. Incidental 2.1 cm heterogeneous nodule in the right thyroid lobe. Recommend dedicated thyroid ultrasound.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: nodule >=1.5 cm in patient >=35 -> thyroid US.

title: CT chest with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No acute cardiopulmonary findings. Incidental 1.0 cm hypodense left thyroid nodule without suspicious features.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: <1.5 cm in a patient >=35 without suspicious features -> no further evaluation.

title: FDG PET/CT (staging)
text: IMPRESSION: 1. FDG-avid right hilar mass consistent with known lung cancer, no distant metastasis. 2. Focal FDG uptake in the right thyroid lobe (SUVmax 8.2) corresponding to a 1.1 cm nodule. Recommend thyroid ultrasound.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: any focal FDG-avid thyroid nodule -> thyroid US regardless of size.

title: 경부 CT
text: 경부 림프절 비대 없음. 갑상선 우엽에 1.2 cm 저음영 결절이 우연히 발견됨.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: in patients <35 years, nodule >=1 cm -> thyroid US.

title: MRI cervical spine
text: IMPRESSION: Multilevel degenerative disc disease, worst at C5-6 with moderate left foraminal narrowing. Incidental 1.3 cm left thyroid nodule.
rationale: ACR incidental thyroid: 1.3 cm in a 50-year-old without suspicious features -> no further work-up.

title: FDG PET/CT
text: IMPRESSION: No FDG-avid metastatic disease in this patient with treated breast cancer. Diffuse homogeneous thyroid FDG uptake, consistent with thyroiditis; no focal thyroid uptake.
rationale: Diffuse thyroid uptake (thyroiditis) does not require ultrasound; only focal uptake does.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Incidental 1.6 cm left adrenal nodule measuring 28 HU on portal venous phase only, indeterminate. No prior imaging available.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 1-2 cm nodule without cancer history -> adrenal CT/MRI in 12 months.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.8 cm right adrenal nodule measuring 6 HU on unenhanced images, consistent with a lipid-rich adenoma. No further imaging needed.
rationale: ACR adrenal: <=10 HU on unenhanced CT is a benign adenoma.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌측 부신에 2.8 cm 결절, 조영 전 25 HU. 비특이적 소견으로 부신 프로토콜 CT 권고.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 2-4 cm nodule -> characterise with adrenal protocol CT/MRI.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: New 1.4 cm right adrenal nodule (35 HU) in this patient with known NSCLC, suspicious for metastasis.
rationale: ACR adrenal: nodule >=1 cm in a patient with cancer -> PET/CT, biopsy or specialist work-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 4.6 cm heterogeneous left adrenal mass with central necrosis. Recommend endocrine and surgical referral.
rationale: ACR adrenal: mass >=4 cm -> referral/resection consideration.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Left adrenal 2.1 cm nodule containing macroscopic fat, consistent with myelolipoma. No follow-up required.
rationale: Myelolipoma is benign; ACR adrenal excludes it.

title: 복부 MRI
text: 우측 부신 1.5 cm 결절, chemical shift 영상에서 뚜렷한 신호 소실을 보여 지방 풍부 선종에 합당함.
rationale: Signal drop on chemical-shift MRI = lipid-rich adenoma (benign).

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Stable 1.9 cm left adrenal nodule compared with CT from 2023 (3 years), consistent with a benign adenoma.
rationale: ACR adrenal: stable >=1 year is benign; no follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: No evidence of metastatic disease. 0.7 cm left adrenal nodule, too small to characterize.
rationale: ACR adrenal: nodules <1 cm need no follow-up even with cancer history.

title: Adrenal protocol CT
text: IMPRESSION: 1.7 cm left adrenal nodule: unenhanced 18 HU, absolute washout 72%. Consistent with adenoma. No further imaging.
rationale: ACR adrenal: absolute washout >=60% = adenoma; already characterised.

title: 복부 CT
text: 간세포암 치료 후 추적. 좌측 부신에 새로 생긴 2.3 cm 결절, 30 HU. 전이 배제 불가.
rationale: ACR adrenal: new nodule >=1 cm in a cancer patient -> work-up for metastasis.

title: 복부 CT
text: 우측 부신 1.3 cm 결절, 문맥기 단일 시기에서 40 HU로 특성화 불가.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 1-2 cm nodule -> 12-month adrenal CT/MRI.

title: MRI abdomen without and with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.5 cm left adrenal nodule without signal loss on opposed-phase imaging, indeterminate. Recommend adrenal protocol CT with washout.
rationale: ACR adrenal: indeterminate 2-4 cm -> adrenal protocol CT characterisation.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌측 부신에 6.0 cm 크기의 종괴, 내부 괴사 및 석회화 동반. 부신피질암 가능성. 내분비내과 및 외과 협진 권고.
rationale: ACR adrenal: mass >=4 cm -> specialist work-up.

title: FDG PET/CT (staging)
text: IMPRESSION: Right adrenal 2.6 cm nodule with FDG uptake greater than liver (SUVmax 6.0) in this patient with esophageal cancer, suspicious for metastasis.
rationale: ACR adrenal: nodule >=1 cm in cancer patient, FDG-avid -> work-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.5 cm left renal cyst with thin smooth wall, 5 HU. Bosniak I. No follow-up.
rationale: Bosniak I simple cyst: no follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.8 cm right renal cystic lesion with multiple thin septa and a minimally thickened smooth wall. Bosniak IIF. Recommend follow-up renal mass protocol MRI in 6 months.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 IIF -> follow-up CT/MRI at 6 months.

title: 신장 초음파
text: 좌신 상극에 1.5 cm 고에코 결절. 혈관근지방종 가능성 높으나 신세포암 배제 위해 조영증강 CT 권고.
rationale: ACR renal: echogenic renal lesion >=1 cm on US is indeterminate -> CT to confirm fat.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.2 cm fat-containing lesion in the left kidney consistent with angiomyolipoma.
rationale: Macroscopic fat = angiomyolipoma: excluded from follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Multiple bilateral subcentimeter renal hypodensities, too small to characterize, statistically likely cysts. No further imaging.
rationale: ACR renal: lesions too small to characterise need no follow-up.

title: MRI kidneys without and with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.9 cm left renal cystic mass with thick, irregular enhancing septa. Bosniak III. Urology consultation recommended.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 III -> urology referral (surgery/ablation/active surveillance discussion).

title: 복부 CT
text: 우신 하극에 4.1 cm 크기의 조영증강되는 고형 종괴, 신세포암 의심. 비뇨의학과 의뢰 바람.
rationale: ACR renal: solid enhancing renal mass -> urology referral.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast (portal venous)
text: IMPRESSION: 1.6 cm homogeneous lesion in the right kidney measuring 45 HU on portal venous phase only, indeterminate (hyperdense cyst versus solid mass).
rationale: ACR renal: homogeneous 21-69 HU on single portal venous phase, >=1 cm -> renal mass protocol imaging.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 2.2 cm solid enhancing right renal mass (unenhanced 32 HU, nephrographic 110 HU), suspicious for renal cell carcinoma. Recommend urology referral and percutaneous biopsy given comorbidities.
rationale: Enhancing solid renal mass -> urology; explicit biopsy recommendation (renal mass not excluded from R036).

title: Renal ultrasound
text: IMPRESSION: Simple 3.1 cm cyst in the right kidney. Otherwise normal kidneys without hydronephrosis.
rationale: Simple renal cyst: no follow-up.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis without contrast
text: IMPRESSION: Homogeneous 1.4 cm left renal lesion measuring 78 HU on unenhanced CT, consistent with a hemorrhagic/proteinaceous cyst (Bosniak II).
rationale: Bosniak v2019: homogeneous >=70 HU on unenhanced CT is Bosniak II -> no follow-up.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌신 2.0 cm 낭종, 얇은 격막 2개 동반. Bosniak II. 추적 불필요.
rationale: Bosniak II: no follow-up.

title: 복부 CT
text: 좌신 중극에 3.4 cm 낭성 종괴, 조영증강되는 벽재결절 동반. Bosniak IV. 비뇨의학과 진료 권고.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 IV -> urology referral.

title: 신장 MRI
text: 우신 2.4 cm 낭종, 다수의 얇은 격막과 경미하게 두꺼워진 매끈한 벽. Bosniak IIF. 6개월 후 추적 검사 권고.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 IIF -> 6-month follow-up imaging (modality not specified).

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1.5 cm heterogeneously hyperattenuating lesion in the upper pole of the left kidney, incompletely characterized on this single-phase study. Recommend renal mass protocol CT.
rationale: ACR renal: indeterminate lesion >=1 cm -> renal mass protocol CT/MRI.

title: MRI/MRCP abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 1.1 cm cystic lesion in the pancreatic body communicating with a side branch, likely side-branch IPMN. No worrisome features. Recommend MRI/MRCP in 2 years.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: <1.5 cm -> MRI every 2 years.

title: 복부 CT
text: 췌장 두부에 3.1 cm 낭성 병변, 주췌관 확장이나 고형 성분 없음. 6개월 후 MRCP 추적 권고.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: >2.5 cm -> MRI at 6 months (or EUS-FNA).

title: MRI/MRCP abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: 2.4 cm cystic lesion in the pancreatic head with a 6 mm enhancing mural nodule; main pancreatic duct dilated to 8 mm. Worrisome features. Recommend EUS and pancreatic surgery consultation.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: mural nodule / MPD >=7 mm -> EUS / pancreas specialist.

title: CT abdomen and pelvis with contrast
text: IMPRESSION: 1. No acute findings. 2. Incidental 0.8 cm cyst in the pancreatic body.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: <1.5 cm -> MRI/MRCP in 2 years.

title: MRCP
text: 췌장 체부에 1.8 cm 분지형 IPMN 의심 병변. 벽재결절 없음, 주췌관 4 mm.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: 1.5-2.5 cm -> MRI/MRCP at 1 year.

title: MRI/MRCP abdomen
text: IMPRESSION: Stable 1.0 cm pancreatic tail cyst, unchanged since 2017 (9 years). Per ACR guidance, surveillance can be discontinued.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst: <1.5 cm stable for 9 years -> stop surveillance.

title: 복부 CT

title: CT Chest with contrast
text:
EXAMINATION: CT CHEST WITH CONTRAST

CLINICAL INFORMATION: 63M, persistent cough x 3 wks. Former smoker, 30 pack-years, quit 2015. r/o pneumonia.

COMPARISON: None available.

TECHNIQUE: Axial CT images of the chest were obtained following IV administration of 70 mL Omnipaque 350. Coronal and sagittal reformats were reviewed.

FINDINGS:
Lungs/airways: Mild centrilobular emphysema, upper lobe predominant. There is a 7 mm solid nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment (series 3, image 45), smooth margins. Recommend follow-up CT chest in 6-12 months. No consolidation. Central airways patent.
Pleura: No plural effusion or pneumothorax.
Mediastinum/hila: No lymphadenopathy by size criteria. Heart size normal. No pericardial effusion.
Vessels: Normal caliber thoracic aorta. Mild coronary artery calcification (LAD).
Upper abdomen: Unremarkable limited evaluation.
Bones/soft tissues: Degenerative changes of the thoracic spine. No suspicious osseous lesion.

IMPRESSION:
1. No pneumonia or acute cardiopulmonary process.
2. Mild centrilobular emphysema.
3. Mild coronary artery calcification.
rationale: Incidental 7 mm solid nodule in a high-risk (former heavy smoker) patient: Fleischner 6-8 mm high risk -> CT 6-12 months. Radiologist explicitly recommends CT in 6-12 months, but only in FINDINGS; the impression omits it.

EXAM: CTA CHEST (PE PROTOCOL)

COMPARISON: none
TECHNIQUE: Bolus-tracked CTA of the pulmonary arteries, 60 mL iodinated contrast. MIP reconstructions.

FINDINGS:

Right heart: RV/LV ratio 0.9. No septal bowing. No reflux of contrast into IVC.
Lungs: Small peripheral wedge-shaped opacity RLL, possibly early infarct. No effusion.
Mediastinum: Unremarkable.
Upper abdomen: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:

2. Possible small RLL pulmonary infarct.

Critical result discussed with Dr. Kim Ji-hoon (ED) by telephone at 14:32 on 2026-01-12; read-back confirmed.

title: Colonoscopic biopsy - sigmoid
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT

SPECIMEN: Colon, sigmoid (25 cm from AV), endoscopic biopsy x4
CLINICAL INFORMATION: 2.5 cm ulcerofungating mass at sigmoid colon. r/o malignancy.

GROSS: Received in formalin labelled with the patient's name and "sigmoid", four tan-pink soft tissue fragments, 0.2-0.4 cm. Entirely submitted in one cassette.

MICROSCOPIC: Sections show colonic mucosa infiltrated by irregular, cribriform glands lined by atypical columnar cells with enlarged hyperchromatic nuclei and dirty necrosis, invading into the lamina propria and muscularis mucosae.

DIAGNOSIS:
Colon, sigmoid, endoscopic biopsy:
  ADENOCARCINOMA, moderately differentiated.

COMMENT: MMR immunohistochemistry has been ordered and will be reported in an addendum.
rationale: Malignant pathology requires patient notification and specialist referral.

title: CT Abdomen/Pelvis with contrast
text:
CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH IV CONTRAST

COMPARISON: None.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase imaging from the dome of the diaphragm to the symphysis pubis. Multiplanar reformats.

FINDINGS:
Lower chest: Clear lung bases.
Liver: Normal size. Two subcentimeter simple cysts, segments 4 and 7 (largest 6 mm).
Gallbladder/biliary: No calcified gallstones. No ductal dilatation.
Pancreas: Unremarkable.
Spleen: Normal.
Adrenals: Normal.

Bowel: Normal appendix measuring 5 mm, air-filled. No bowel wall thickening or obstruction.
Peritoneum: No free fluid or free air.
Vessels: Normal caliber abdominal aorta, 1.9 cm.
Lymph nodes: None enlarged.
Pelvis: Bladder and prostate unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:

2. Simple renal cysts (Bosniak I) and small hepatic cysts, benign; no follow-up needed.
No other significant abnormality.

title: Low-dose CT Lung Cancer Screening
text:
LOW-DOSE CT CHEST - LUNG CANCER SCREENING (ANNUAL)

Indication: Annual screening. Current smoker, 45 pack-years.
Comparison: LDCT 2025-01-17.
Technique: Non-contrast low-dose helical CT, 1 mm reconstructions. CTDIvol 1.4 mGy.

Findings:
- Lungs: 5 mm solid nodule left lower lobe (im 188), unchanged from prior (5 mm). 3 mm perifissural nodule RML, unchanged. Moderate centrilobular emphysema.
- Pleura: no effusion.
- Heart/mediastinum: Moderate coronary calcification. No adenopathy.
- Other: Unremarkable upper abdomen.

Impression:
Lung-RADS 2 - Benign appearance or behavior.
Continue annual screening with LDCT in 12 months.
S modifier: moderate coronary artery calcification; correlate with cardiovascular risk management.
rationale: Lung-RADS 2: routine annual screening only, no category 3/4 obligation; no finding-specific follow-up.

CLINICAL HISTORY: Newly diagnosed sigmoid adenocarcinoma. Staging.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
CHEST: No pulmonary nodules. No adenopathy. No effusion.
LIVER: No focal lesion.
ADRENALS: 1.6 cm right adrenal nodule, 48 HU on portal venous phase. No prior for comparison. Left adrenal normal.
KIDNEYS, PANCREAS, SPLEEN: Unremarkable.
BOWEL: Circumferential wall thickening of the sigmoid colon over 5 cm with pericolic stranding and two 7 mm pericolic nodes, compatible with known primary.
IMPRESSION:
1. Known sigmoid carcinoma with locoregional nodes.
2. 1.6 cm indeterminate right adrenal nodule in a patient with known malignancy; metastasis not excluded.
RECOMMENDATION: FDG PET/CT or adrenal chemical-shift MRI for characterization; tissue sampling if indeterminate.
rationale: Adrenal nodule >=1 cm in a patient with cancer: specialist work-up (escalation rule).

title: 복부 CT
text:
Abdomen CT (dynamic, renal protocol 아님)
임상: 59M, 건강검진 US상 Lt kidney mass 의심.

판독소견:
Lt kidney upper pole에 3.1 cm exophytic solid mass, heterogeneous enhancement (unenh 34 HU → nephrographic 112 HU). 지방 성분 없음.
Lt renal vein, IVC 침범 없음. Regional LN enlargement 없음.
Rt kidney: 1 cm 미만 cyst 수개, too small to characterize.
Liver, pancreas: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Lt renal enhancing solid mass 3.1 cm — r/o RCC (cT1a).
2. Rt renal small cysts.

비뇨의학과 협진 요망.
rationale: Solid enhancing renal mass needs urology referral.

title: US Retroperitoneum (Renal)
text:
EXAM: US RENAL COMPLETE
HISTORY: Flank pain.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
Right kidney: 10.8 cm. Normal echogenicity. No hydronephrosis.
Left kidney: 11.2 cm. 2.2 cm cystic lesion in the interpolar region with two thin internal septations and possible mildly thickened wall segment; internal vascularity cannot be assessed reliably. No hydronephrosis. No stones.
Bladder: Partially distended, unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. 2.2 cm complex cystic lesion of the left kidney, indeterminate by ultrasound (Bosniak classification cannot be assigned on US).
RECOMMENDATION: Renal mass protocol MRI for further characterization.
rationale: Indeterminate renal lesion >=1 cm: renal mass protocol MRI recommended.

title: CT Abdomen renal mass protocol
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN RENAL MASS PROTOCOL
CLINICAL HISTORY: Complex renal cyst on outside ultrasound.
TECHNIQUE: Unenhanced, corticomedullary and nephrographic phases.
COMPARISON: Outside US 2026-03-30 (report only).
FINDINGS:
Right kidney: 3.0 cm cyst of the lower pole with multiple (>4) thin, smooth enhancing septa and no measurable enhancing nodule. Wall smooth, 2 mm.
Left kidney: Normal.
Adrenals, liver, pancreas: Normal.
IMPRESSION:
Bosniak IIF right renal cyst (v2019), 3.0 cm.
RECOMMENDATION: Follow-up renal mass protocol CT in 6 months, then annually for 5 years if stable.
rationale: Bosniak IIF: 6-month CT/MRI; explicit CT follow-up.

title: MRI 췌장 / MRCP
text:
검사명: Pancreas MRI with MRCP
임상정보: 66F, 타병원 CT에서 우연히 발견된 pancreatic cyst.
비교: 외부 CT 2026-04-02 (영상 판독 참고)

판독소견:
Pancreas body에 1.2 cm unilocular cystic lesion, MPD와 communication 의심 → r/o side-branch IPMN.
Enhancing mural nodule 없음. Thickened/enhancing cyst wall 없음. MPD 직경 2 mm, 정상.
Liver, CBD: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Pancreatic body 1.2 cm cyst, probable BD-IPMN, without worrisome features or high-risk stigmata.

권고: 2년 후 MRI/MRCP f/u 권함 (ACR 2017 기준 <1.5 cm).
rationale: Pancreatic cyst <1.5 cm: MRI/MRCP in 2 years; MRI explicitly recommended.

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Weight loss, epigastric discomfort.
COMPARISON: CT 2024-08-11.
FINDINGS:
PANCREAS: Multilocular cystic lesion of the pancreatic head measuring 2.8 cm (previously 1.9 cm), containing a 5 mm enhancing mural nodule. Main pancreatic duct dilated to 6 mm (previously 3 mm). No pancreatic atrophy.
LIVER/BILIARY: No intrahepatic biliary dilatation. CBD 6 mm.
SPLEEN, ADRENALS, KIDNEYS: Normal.
VASCULATURE: No arterial encasement.
IMPRESSION:
Enlarging pancreatic head cystic lesion (1.9 -> 2.8 cm) with enhancing mural nodule and main duct dilatation, worrisome for IPMN with high-risk features.
RECOMMENDATION: Endoscopic ultrasound with FNA and pancreatic surgery consultation.
rationale: Pancreatic cyst with enhancing mural nodule and growth: EUS/pancreas specialist (escalation rule).

title: CT Neck Soft Tissue with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT SOFT TISSUE NECK WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Sore throat, rule out peritonsillar abscess.
TECHNIQUE: Axial images from skull base to thoracic inlet after IV contrast.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
PHARYNX: Mild bilateral tonsillar enlargement with striated enhancement. No rim-enhancing fluid collection.
LYMPH NODES: Reactive-appearing level II nodes bilaterally, up to 11 mm short axis.
THYROID: 1.8 cm heterogeneous nodule in the left thyroid lobe. Right lobe normal.
SALIVARY GLANDS: Normal.
BONES/AIRWAY: Unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. Acute tonsillitis without abscess.
2. 1.8 cm left thyroid nodule.
RECOMMENDATION: Dedicated thyroid ultrasound for the incidental thyroid nodule (ACR incidental thyroid nodule guidance, >=1.5 cm in patient >=35 years).
rationale: Incidental thyroid nodule >=1.5 cm on CT: thyroid ultrasound.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text:
Thyroid US
임상: 건강검진 갑상선 결절, 추가평가.

판독소견:
Rt lobe mid portion: 1.7 x 1.3 x 1.2 cm solid hypoechoic (marked hypoechogenicity) nodule, irregular margin, taller-than-wide, punctate echogenic foci (+).
ACR TI-RADS: composition 2 + echogenicity 3 + shape 3 + margin 2 + echogenic foci 3 = 13 points → TR5.
Lt lobe: 4 mm cyst.
Cervical LN: suspicious LN 없음.

결론:
Rt thyroid nodule 1.7 cm, ACR TI-RADS TR5 — r/o PTC.
(TR5 FNA 기준 ≥1.0 cm 충족)

권고: US-guided FNA 권함.
rationale: TI-RADS TR5 >=1 cm: FNA recommended.

title: 갑상선 초음파
text:
갑상선 초음파 판독지
비교: 2025-06-10 thyroid US

소견:
Lt lobe: 1.2 cm mixed cystic and solid, isoechoic, smooth margin, no echogenic foci. 이전 1.1 cm, 큰 변화 없음.
ACR TI-RADS 2 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 3 points → TR3.
Rt lobe: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Lt thyroid nodule 1.2 cm, TR3.
TR3 기준 FNA threshold 2.5 cm 및 f/u threshold 1.5 cm 모두 미만으로 추가 f/u 필요 없음.
rationale: TR3 nodule below both the 1.5 cm follow-up and 2.5 cm FNA thresholds: no action.

title: US Thyroid
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND THYROID
CLINICAL HISTORY: Palpable fullness, right neck.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
Right lobe: 4.9 x 1.8 x 1.7 cm. 1.2 cm solid, hypoechoic nodule, smooth margins, wider-than-tall, no echogenic foci. TI-RADS points: 2 + 2 + 0 + 0 + 0 = 4 (TR4).
Left lobe: 4.6 x 1.6 x 1.5 cm, no nodules.
Isthmus: 3 mm.
Lymph nodes: No abnormal cervical nodes.
IMPRESSION:
1.2 cm right thyroid nodule, ACR TI-RADS TR4. This is below the 1.5 cm FNA threshold but meets the 1.0 cm threshold for surveillance.
RECOMMENDATION: Follow-up thyroid ultrasound in 1 year.
rationale: TR4 1.0-1.4 cm: no FNA, ultrasound follow-up at 1 year.

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Left lower quadrant pain, r/o diverticulitis.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
BOWEL: Sigmoid diverticulosis with mild pericolic fat stranding adjacent to a mid-sigmoid diverticulum; no abscess or free air.
VASCULATURE: Infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm measuring 3.7 x 3.6 cm (maximal outer-to-outer), with mural thrombus. No periaortic stranding. Iliac arteries 1.4 cm.
LIVER, PANCREAS, KIDNEYS, ADRENALS: Unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. Acute uncomplicated sigmoid diverticulitis.
2. 3.7 cm infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm.
RECOMMENDATION: Ultrasound surveillance of the AAA in 2 years (SVS guideline interval for 3.5-3.9 cm).
rationale: AAA 3.5-3.9 cm: surveillance in 2 years; US recommended.

title: 복부 CT
text:
Abdomen-pelvis CT (enhanced)
임상: 77M, 요통.

판독소견:
Infrarenal AAA, maximal diameter 5.8 cm (outer-to-outer), eccentric mural thrombus 동반. 주위 hematoma나 fat stranding 없음 → rupture 소견 없음.
Both CIA 1.6 cm.
L-spine: L3-4, L4-5 degenerative change.
그 외 장기 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Infrarenal AAA 5.8 cm, no evidence of rupture.
2. L-spine spondylosis.

권고: 수술 기준(5.5 cm) 이상으로 혈관외과 의뢰 요망.
rationale: Asymptomatic AAA >=5.5 cm: vascular surgery referral.

title: CTA Abdomen Pelvis
text:
CTA ABDOMEN/PELVIS - STAT
HISTORY: Hypotension, acute back pain, pulsatile mass.
FINDINGS: 7.4 cm infrarenal AAA with large left retroperitoneal hematoma extending into the perirenal space and active contrast extravasation from the left posterolateral wall. Draped aorta sign.
IMPRESSION:
Ruptured infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm with active extravasation.
Discussed with Dr. Patel, vascular surgery, at 21:47 by telephone; patient being taken to OR.
rationale: Ruptured AAA is a critical finding (R035); also AAA above repair threshold requiring vascular surgery (R045).

title: Screening Mammogram Bilateral
text:
EXAM: BILATERAL SCREENING MAMMOGRAM WITH TOMOSYNTHESIS
HISTORY: Routine screening. No symptoms.
COMPARISON: 2025-06-30, 2024-07-02.
BREAST COMPOSITION: Scattered areas of fibroglandular density (b).
FINDINGS: No suspicious masses, calcifications, or architectural distortion in either breast. Stable benign-appearing intramammary lymph node, right upper outer quadrant.
IMPRESSION: Negative.
BI-RADS 1: Negative.
RECOMMENDATION: Routine annual screening mammography.
rationale: BI-RADS 1 negative screening; routine annual screening only.

title: 유방촬영술 및 유방초음파
text:
Mammography (Bilateral) + Breast US
임상: Lt breast palpable mass.
비교: 2024 mammo (외부)

판독소견:
Mammo: Heterogeneously dense breast (c). Lt UOQ에 1.4 cm irregular high-density mass with spiculated margin. 이전 영상에서는 보이지 않음.
US: Lt 2시 방향 FN 6 cm, 1.4 x 1.2 cm irregular, non-parallel, hypoechoic mass with angular margin, posterior shadowing. Lt axilla LN cortical thickening 없음.
Rt breast: 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Lt breast 2 o'clock 1.4 cm mass, BI-RADS category 5 (highly suggestive of malignancy).

권고: US-guided core needle biopsy 권함.
rationale: BI-RADS 5: tissue diagnosis (R018 governs, not R036).

title: US Breast Left Diagnostic
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND LEFT BREAST, TARGETED
HISTORY: 34F, palpable lump left breast 10 o'clock, first noticed 2 weeks ago.
FINDINGS: At the site of palpable concern, left breast 10 o'clock 4 cm from nipple, there is an 8 x 5 x 4 mm oval, circumscribed, parallel, hypoechoic mass without posterior features or internal vascularity, compatible with probable fibroadenoma. No axillary adenopathy.
IMPRESSION:
Probably benign left breast mass, likely fibroadenoma.
BI-RADS 3: Probably benign.
RECOMMENDATION: Short-interval follow-up left breast ultrasound in 6 months.
rationale: BI-RADS 3 on US: 6-month follow-up ultrasound (not BI-RADS 4/5).

title: Diagnostic Mammogram Right
text:
EXAM: DIAGNOSTIC MAMMOGRAM RIGHT BREAST WITH MAGNIFICATION VIEWS
HISTORY: Recall from screening 2026-07-08 for calcifications.
FINDINGS: Magnification CC and ML views demonstrate a 9 mm group of fine pleomorphic calcifications in the right breast upper outer quadrant, middle depth, in a grouped distribution. No associated mass. No new findings elsewhere.
IMPRESSION:
Suspicious grouped fine pleomorphic calcifications, right breast UOQ.
BI-RADS 4B: Moderate suspicion for malignancy.
RECOMMENDATION: Stereotactic biopsy is recommended. Results were discussed with the patient at the time of the exam.
rationale: BI-RADS 4B requires stereotactic biopsy.

title: 간 MRI (Gd-EOB)
text:
Liver MRI (primovist)
임상: HBV LC, HCC surveillance. 초음파에서 S6 nodule 의심.
비교: 2026-01 Liver US

판독소견:
S6에 1.6 cm nodule: arterial phase hyperenhancement (nonrim) 있으나 nonperipheral washout 및 enhancing capsule 없음. HBP hypointensity. T2 mild hyperintensity.
Liver surface nodular, splenomegaly (14 cm), small varices.
Ascites 없음. PV patent.

결론:
1. S6 1.6 cm observation — LI-RADS LR-3 (intermediate probability).
2. Liver cirrhosis with portal hypertension.

권고: 3-6개월 후 multiphasic MRI f/u 권함.
rationale: LR-3: repeat MRI in 3-6 months.

title: MRI Liver with contrast
text:
EXAM: MRI ABDOMEN WITH AND WITHOUT CONTRAST (LIVER PROTOCOL)
CLINICAL HISTORY: Hepatitis C cirrhosis, rising AFP.
COMPARISON: MRI 2026-02-02.
FINDINGS:
LIVER: Cirrhotic morphology. Segment 8 observation measuring 2.4 cm (previously 1.1 cm) with nonrim arterial phase hyperenhancement, nonperipheral washout on portal venous phase and an enhancing capsule. No tumor in vein. Portal veins patent.
SPLEEN: 15 cm.
OTHER: Small volume ascites.
IMPRESSION:
1. Segment 8 2.4 cm observation, LI-RADS LR-5 (definitely HCC), with threshold growth.
2. Cirrhosis with portal hypertension.
Noninvasive diagnosis of HCC is established; biopsy is not required. Findings will be presented at multidisciplinary liver tumor board.
rationale: LR-5 is a definitive noninvasive diagnosis; biopsy explicitly not required and no imaging follow-up requested. Actionable clinically (tumor board) but no catalog rule fits; R036 must not fire.

title: MRI Prostate multiparametric
text:
EXAM: MRI PROSTATE WITHOUT AND WITH CONTRAST (mpMRI)
CLINICAL HISTORY: PSA 7.8 ng/mL, rising. No prior biopsy.
TECHNIQUE: 3T multiparametric MRI, T2, DWI (b=1400), DCE.
FINDINGS:
Prostate volume 42 cc; PSA density 0.19.
Lesion 1: Left posterolateral peripheral zone, mid gland, 1.1 cm focal markedly hypointense ADC / markedly hyperintense high-b DWI lesion. DCE positive. No extraprostatic extension. PI-RADS 4.
Transition zone: BPH nodules, PI-RADS 2.
Seminal vesicles, lymph nodes, bones: Unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion left PZ mid gland, 1.1 cm.
RECOMMENDATION: MRI-targeted biopsy of the left PZ lesion.
rationale: PI-RADS 4: radiologist recommends targeted biopsy.

title: 골반 초음파
text:
Pelvis US (TVS)

Uterus: 정상 크기, myoma 1.5 cm (intramural).

Rt adnexal multilocular cyst with solid component, O-RADS US 4 (intermediate risk).

title: US Pelvis Transvaginal
text:
EXAM: US PELVIS TRANSABDOMINAL AND TRANSVAGINAL

Left ovary: Normal with follicles.
No free fluid.
IMPRESSION:
3.0 cm simple right ovarian cyst in a premenopausal patient, O-RADS US 2 (almost certainly benign). No follow-up imaging is needed for a simple cyst <=5 cm in a premenopausal patient.
rationale: O-RADS 2 simple cyst <=5 cm premenopausal: no follow-up.

Chest AP (portable), ER

Rt large pneumothorax.

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis - ED
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN PELVIS WITH IV CONTRAST - ED
HISTORY: Acute abdominal pain, peritonitis on exam, on NSAIDs.

Pneumoperitoneum with findings suggesting perforated duodenal ulcer.
CRITICAL RESULT: Communicated to Dr. Lindqvist (surgery) by phone at 16:05 on 2026-03-05.
rationale: Free intraperitoneal air is a critical finding.

title: CT Chest follow-up
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Follow-up of left upper lobe nodule.
COMPARISON: CT chest 2025-09-12 and 2025-03-10.
FINDINGS:
LUNGS: Left upper lobe solid nodule now measures 9 mm (image 51), previously 7 mm (2025-09-12) and 6 mm (2025-03-10). Margins now lobulated. No new nodules. Mild emphysema.
MEDIASTINUM: No adenopathy.
PLEURA: No effusion.
IMPRESSION:
Interval growth of left upper lobe solid nodule (6 -> 7 -> 9 mm over 12 months), suspicious for neoplasm.
RECOMMENDATION: PET/CT and pulmonology referral for consideration of tissue sampling.
rationale: Growing solid nodule: work-up (PET/CT, tissue, referral) rather than routine Fleischner.

title: CT Chest follow-up
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: 24-month follow-up of pulmonary nodule.
COMPARISON: CT 2025-03-20, 2024-03-18.
FINDINGS: The 6 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe (image 112) is unchanged in size and morphology from 2024-03-18. No new nodules. No adenopathy.
IMPRESSION:
Stable 6 mm right lower lobe nodule over 24 months, consistent with a benign nodule. No further imaging follow-up is required per Fleischner Society guidelines.
rationale: Solid nodule stable for 2 years: follow-up complete.

title: 흉부 CT f/u
text:
Chest CT (non-enhanced) f/u
임상: 47F, 2026-01 RML pneumonia 치료 후 f/u.

RML pneumonia 호전, 이전 nodular opacity 소실 (resolved).
추가 f/u 불필요.
rationale: Previously seen nodular opacity resolved; follow-up complete.

title: CT Chest with contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Chronic cough, 40 pack-year current smoker.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
LUNGS: Multiple solid pulmonary nodules: 7 mm right upper lobe (image 40), 6 mm right lower lobe (image 98), 5 mm left lower lobe (image 120). No consolidation. Moderate centrilobular emphysema. Bronchial wall thickening.
MEDIASTINUM: No adenopathy. No effusion.
UPPER ABDOMEN: Unremarkable.
IMPRESSION:
1. Multiple solid pulmonary nodules, largest 7 mm, in a high-risk patient.

RECOMMENDATION: Per Fleischner Society 2017 (multiple solid nodules 6-8 mm, high risk), follow-up CT chest at 3-6 months, then at 18-24 months.
rationale: Multiple solid 6-8 mm nodules, high risk: CT at 3-6 months.

title: CT Chest without contrast
text:

rationale: Single pure GGN >=6 mm: CT at 6-12 months.

title: CT Abdomen Pelvis without contrast (stone protocol)
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITHOUT CONTRAST, RENAL STONE PROTOCOL

IMPRESSION:

rationale: 2.6 cm indeterminate (>10 HU unenhanced) adrenal nodule mentioned only in FINDINGS; ACR advises characterisation for 2-4 cm.

title: 복부 CT (충수염 의심)

Abdomen-Pelvis CT (enhanced)

Acute appendicitis with appendicolith, no perforation.

title: 뇌 CT
text:
Brain CT (non-enhanced)
임상: 교통사고 후 두통, 의식 명료.

판독소견:
Intracranial hemorrhage 없음. Midline shift 없음.

2. Lt frontal scalp hematoma.

rationale: Negative trauma head CT.

title: MRI Brain without and with contrast
text:
EXAM: MRI BRAIN WITHOUT AND WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Chronic headaches.
COMPARISON: None.
FINDINGS:
There is a 1.2 cm extra-axial, dural-based, homogeneously enhancing mass along the right frontal convexity with a dural tail, consistent with a meningioma. No mass effect or surrounding edema.
Scattered T2/FLAIR white matter hyperintensities, likely chronic microvascular change, mild for age.

IMPRESSION:

text:

BIOMARKERS: ER positive (95%, strong), PR positive (60%), HER2 1+ (negative), Ki-67 15%.
Concordant with imaging. Results communicated to ordering provider via EHR inbox.
rationale: Invasive breast carcinoma: notification and referral (inbox message is not a referral).

title: Surgical Pathology - CT-guided lung biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Right upper lobe nodule, CT-guided 18G core biopsy (3 cores).
CLINICAL HISTORY: 1.5 cm RUL nodule, PET SUV 3.1. Differential diagnosis: primary lung adenocarcinoma vs. carcinoid vs. granulomatous infection.
MICROSCOPIC: Lung parenchyma with well-formed necrotizing granulomas with central caseous-type necrosis and surrounding epithelioid histiocytes and multinucleated giant cells. GMS and AFB stains negative for organisms. No atypical epithelial cells.
DIAGNOSIS:
Lung, right upper lobe, CT-guided core biopsy:
- NECROTIZING GRANULOMATOUS INFLAMMATION.
- Special stains (AFB, GMS) negative for microorganisms.
- NEGATIVE FOR MALIGNANCY.
Comment: Correlation with cultures is recommended.
rationale: Benign granulomatous inflammation; malignancy appears only in the clinical differential.
