rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: new solid nodule 6 to <8 mm on annual screening is category 4A, managed with 3-month LDCT (or PET/CT).

title: MRI Abdomen (MRCP)
text:
EXAM: MRI ABDOMEN WITH MRCP
CLINICAL HISTORY: Abnormal LFTs. Query choledocholithiasis.
TECHNIQUE: Multiplanar T1/T2, DWI and 3D MRCP; no IV contrast.
COMPARISON: US abdomen 2026-01-12.

FINDINGS:
Biliary: No choledocholithiasis. CBD 5 mm. Gallbladder contains small stones.
Pancreas: 1.2 cm unilocular T2-hyperintense cyst in the pancreatic body without septation, solid component or communication clearly seen; probable side-branch IPMN. Main pancreatic duct 2 mm.
Liver: Normal.
Kidneys, spleen, adrenals: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. Cholelithiasis. No choledocholithiasis.
2. 1.2 cm pancreatic body cyst without worrisome features. Recommend MRI/MRCP surveillance in 2 years (ACR 2017).
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst white paper 2017: incidental cyst <1.5 cm in a patient <65 needs MRI/MRCP in 2 years.

title: Breast Ultrasound, Right
text:
EXAM: TARGETED ULTRASOUND RIGHT BREAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: 28F, palpable lump right breast 10 o'clock.
TECHNIQUE: High-frequency linear transducer, targeted to palpable area.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
At the site of palpable concern, right breast 10 o'clock, 4 cm from the nipple, there is an oval, circumscribed, parallel, hypoechoic mass measuring 1.1 x 0.6 x 0.9 cm without posterior features or internal vascularity. Imaging features are those of a probable fibroadenoma.
No other mass. Right axilla normal.

IMPRESSION:
Probably benign mass, right breast 10 o'clock, likely fibroadenoma.
Recommend short-interval follow-up ultrasound of the right breast in 6 months.
BI-RADS 3: Probably benign.
rationale: BI-RADS 3 on ultrasound is managed with a 6-month short-interval follow-up ultrasound.

title: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITH IV CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Left upper quadrant discomfort.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Spleen: 2.1 cm well-defined hypoattenuating lesion in the splenic lower pole, 28 HU, with no enhancing rim, imperceptible wall, not clearly a simple cyst (series 3, image 70). Spleen normal in size.
Liver: Normal.
Pancreas: Normal.
Kidneys and adrenals: Normal.
Bowel: Normal.
Pelvis: Small physiological left ovarian follicle.

IMPRESSION:
Indeterminate 2.1 cm splenic lesion, likely benign (cyst or haemangioma). Recommend follow-up CT abdomen with contrast in 6 months to document stability.
rationale: ACR spleen incidental-findings guidance: indeterminate 1-3 cm splenic lesion without cancer history can be followed; the report explicitly recommends CT in 6 months.

title: Diagnostic Mammogram, Bilateral
text:
EXAM: BILATERAL DIAGNOSTIC MAMMOGRAM; ULTRASOUND RIGHT BREAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Palpable right breast mass, nipple retraction for 2 months.
COMPARISON: None available (no prior mammography).
BREAST COMPOSITION: Almost entirely fatty (a).

FINDINGS:
Right breast: 2.4 cm irregular, spiculated high-density mass at 12 o'clock, posterior depth, with associated fine pleomorphic calcifications and skin/nipple retraction. Ultrasound shows a 2.3 x 1.9 cm irregular hypoechoic mass with posterior shadowing. Two morphologically abnormal right axillary lymph nodes with cortical thickening up to 5 mm.
Left breast: No suspicious findings.

IMPRESSION:
Right breast mass at 12 o'clock with abnormal right axillary nodes.
The overall assessment is highly suggestive of malignancy.
BI-RADS: 5.
Ultrasound-guided biopsy of the breast mass and the most abnormal axillary node is recommended; appointment to be arranged by the breast unit.
rationale: BI-RADS 5 (stated in a separate line) requires tissue diagnosis.

title: CT Chest with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT THORAX WITH IV CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Weight loss, ex-smoker. Rule out malignancy.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase CT thorax, 1 mm reconstructions.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
LUNGS AND AIRWAYS:
- Part-solid nodule in the right upper lobe posterior segment, overall 12 mm, with a central solid component measuring 4 mm (series 6, images 33-38).
- Mild paraseptal emphysema.
- No consolidation or effusion.
MEDIASTINUM/HILA: No lymphadenopathy.
HEART/VESSELS: Normal heart size. Atherosclerotic aorta of normal calibre.
UPPER ABDOMEN: Unremarkable.
MUSCULOSKELETAL: No destructive lesion.

IMPRESSION:
Part-solid right upper lobe nodule (12 mm, solid component 4 mm). Recommend repeat CT chest in 3-6 months to assess persistence, per Fleischner Society 2017.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: part-solid nodule >=6 mm needs CT at 3-6 months to confirm persistence; solid component <6 mm so no immediate work-up.

title: CT Chest without Contrast - Nodule Follow-up
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Follow-up of part-solid nodule.
TECHNIQUE: Low-dose non-contrast CT chest, 1 mm reconstructions.
COMPARISON: CT chest 2026-03-30 and 2025-12-18.

FINDINGS:
The part-solid nodule in the left lower lobe superior segment persists, overall 15 mm (previously 15 mm), solid component 7 mm (previously 6 mm) (series 3, image 140). No new nodules.
Mild emphysema.
No lymphadenopathy. No effusion.

IMPRESSION:
Persistent part-solid left lower lobe nodule with a 7 mm solid component, now present on three examinations. Findings are concerning for adenocarcinoma spectrum. Recommend PET/CT and/or tissue sampling, and referral to thoracic surgery/MDT.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: persistent part-solid nodule with solid component >=6 mm is highly suspicious and needs PET/CT, sampling or resection.

title: CT Head without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT HEAD WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Fall, on apixaban, new confusion.
TECHNIQUE: Axial non-contrast CT brain.
COMPARISON: CT head 2025-02-03.

FINDINGS:
Acute right holohemispheric subdural haematoma, maximum thickness 11 mm, with 6 mm leftward midline shift. Effacement of the right lateral ventricle. No uncal herniation.
Chronic small vessel ischaemic change. Old left occipital infarct.
No skull fracture.

IMPRESSION:
Acute right subdural haematoma, 11 mm, with 6 mm midline shift.

CRITICAL RESULT: Called to and acknowledged by Dr. P. Okafor (on-call neurosurgery registrar) at 22:47, 2026-04-11. ED consultant also informed.
rationale: Acute SDH with midline shift is a critical finding; direct communication to the responsible clinician is documented in the report. [Relabelled to the project convention: a critical finding is R035 even when the report documents the call; the loop then opens and closes at once.]

title: Surgical Pathology - Prostate Needle Biopsies
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Prostate, transperineal needle biopsies: 12 systematic cores (A-L) and 3 targeted cores (M, PI-RADS 3 lesion left mid peripheral zone)
CLINICAL HISTORY: PSA 6.8 ng/mL, PI-RADS 3.

MICROSCOPIC/DIAGNOSIS:
A-L. Benign prostatic tissue with focal chronic inflammation. NEGATIVE FOR MALIGNANCY.
M. Benign prostatic tissue with partial atrophy and chronic prostatitis. NEGATIVE FOR MALIGNANCY. No high-grade PIN.

COMMENT: The targeted lesion is explained by chronic prostatitis/atrophy. No atypical small acinar proliferation.
rationale: All prostate cores are negative for malignancy without atypia; no abnormal-pathology loop is opened (PSA follow-up is routine clinical care).

title: CT Chest without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Chronic dyspnoea. Former smoker, quit 10 years ago.
TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT chest, 1 mm.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Lungs: Multiple solid pulmonary nodules: 7 mm right upper lobe (series 2, image 55), 6 mm right lower lobe (image 160), 6 mm left lower lobe (image 171). No calcification. Mild bronchiectasis in the lingula.
Airways: Mild bronchial wall thickening.
Mediastinum: No adenopathy.
Heart: Mild cardiomegaly.
Upper abdomen: No abnormality.

IMPRESSION:
1. Multiple solid pulmonary nodules, largest 7 mm. Per Fleischner 2017 (multiple, 6-8 mm, high risk), recommend CT chest in 3-6 months, then at 18-24 months.
2. Mild lingular bronchiectasis.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: multiple solid 6-8 mm nodules need CT at 3-6 months.

title: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Constipation, lower abdominal discomfort.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase.
COMPARISON: US abdomen 2024-02-11 (aorta 4.6 cm).

FINDINGS:
Aorta: Fusiform infrarenal AAA measuring 5.2 cm maximal outer-to-outer diameter (previously 4.6 cm on ultrasound in 2024). Eccentric mural thrombus. No periaortic stranding or retroperitoneal haematoma.
Bowel: Large faecal load. No obstruction. Sigmoid diverticulosis.
Liver, pancreas, spleen, kidneys, adrenals: Unremarkable.
Bladder, uterus: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. Faecal loading.
2. Infrarenal AAA 5.2 cm, increased from 4.6 cm. Recommend vascular surgery referral.
rationale: SVS 2018: AAA >=5.0 cm in a woman meets the repair threshold and needs vascular surgery referral; sex is decisive.

title: Screening Mammogram, Bilateral
text:
EXAM: BILATERAL SCREENING DIGITAL MAMMOGRAM WITH TOMOSYNTHESIS
CLINICAL HISTORY: Routine screening. No breast complaints. No family history.
COMPARISON: 2024-01-15 and 2022-01-11.
BREAST COMPOSITION: Heterogeneously dense (c), which may obscure small masses.

FINDINGS:
Right breast: No suspicious mass, calcification or architectural distortion.
Left breast: New focal asymmetry in the upper outer quadrant, posterior depth, seen on the CC and MLO tomosynthesis images, not present on prior studies. No associated calcifications.
No suspicious axillary lymph nodes.

IMPRESSION:
New focal asymmetry, left breast upper outer quadrant. Recommend recall for additional imaging evaluation with diagnostic mammography and targeted left breast ultrasound within 30 days.

BI-RADS CATEGORY 0: Incomplete - Need additional imaging evaluation.
rationale: BI-RADS 0 requires recall for additional imaging; the report explicitly recommends a targeted breast ultrasound within 30 days.

title: Chest Radiograph AP (Portable)
text:
EXAM: CHEST X-RAY, AP PORTABLE
CLINICAL HISTORY: Post-operative day 2 cholecystectomy, mild hypoxia.
COMPARISON: Pre-op CXR 2026-04-20.

FINDINGS:
Lines/tubes: None.
Lungs: Small left basilar linear opacity, most likely plate atelectasis. No focal consolidation. No pneumothorax.
Pleura: No effusion.
Heart and mediastinum: Normal.
Sub-diaphragmatic: Small amount of free air under the right hemidiaphragm, expected post-laparoscopy.

IMPRESSION:
Left basal atelectasis. Expected post-operative pneumoperitoneum.
A follow-up radiograph could be considered if symptoms persist, at the discretion of the referring clinician.
rationale: The repeat radiograph is only conditional ('could be considered if symptoms persist'); post-laparoscopic free air is expected and not critical.

title: CT Pulmonary Angiogram
text:
EXAM: CT ANGIOGRAM CHEST - PULMONARY EMBOLISM PROTOCOL
CLINICAL HISTORY: Post-op day 4 knee replacement, sudden hypoxia.
TECHNIQUE: CTPA with bolus tracking.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Large saddle embolus at the main pulmonary artery bifurcation extending into both main and lobar arteries. RV/LV ratio 1.5 with straightening of the interventricular septum and contrast reflux into the IVC and hepatic veins, indicating right heart strain.
Lungs: Bibasal atelectasis. No consolidation.
Pleura: No effusion.

IMPRESSION:
Saddle pulmonary embolus with CT signs of right ventricular strain.
rationale: ACR communication parameter/Joint Commission: massive PE with RV strain is a critical finding and no direct clinician communication is documented.

title: CT Chest without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: 24-month follow-up of left upper lobe nodule.
TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT chest, 1 mm reconstructions.
COMPARISON: CT chest 2025-02-20, 2024-08-15 and 2024-02-22.

FINDINGS:
The 6 mm solid nodule in the left upper lobe (series 3, image 52) is unchanged in size and morphology since 2024-02-22, i.e. stable for 2 years.
No new pulmonary nodules. Mild emphysema.
No lymphadenopathy or effusion.

IMPRESSION:
Left upper lobe 6 mm solid nodule stable over 24 months, consistent with a benign nodule. No further follow-up imaging is recommended.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: a solid nodule stable for 2 years needs no further follow-up.

title: Thyroid Ultrasound
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND THYROID
CLINICAL HISTORY: Palpable right thyroid nodule.
TECHNIQUE: High-frequency linear transducer, grey-scale and Doppler.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Right lobe: 4.8 x 1.6 x 1.5 cm. Left lobe: 4.5 x 1.4 x 1.4 cm. Isthmus 3 mm.

Nodule 1 (right mid): 1.3 x 1.0 x 1.1 cm
- Composition: solid (2)
- Echogenicity: very hypoechoic (3)
- Shape: taller-than-wide (3)
- Margin: irregular (2)
- Echogenic foci: punctate echogenic foci (3)
- Total 13 points: ACR TI-RADS TR5.

Nodule 2 (left lower): 0.6 cm spongiform nodule, TR1.

Cervical lymph nodes: No abnormal nodes.

IMPRESSION:
1. Right thyroid nodule 1.3 cm, TI-RADS TR5. FNA recommended.
2. Left spongiform nodule TR1, no FNA or follow-up.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS 2017: TR5 nodule >=1.0 cm meets FNA criteria.

title: CT Pulmonary Angiogram
text:
EXAM: CT ANGIOGRAPHY CHEST (PE PROTOCOL)
CLINICAL HISTORY: 58F, pleuritic chest pain, D-dimer 1.4. Ex-smoker (30 pack-years, quit 2019).
TECHNIQUE: Helical CT of the chest after 70 mL Omnipaque 350 IV, bolus-tracked to the main pulmonary artery. Axial 1 mm with MIP and coronal/sagittal reformats.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Pulmonary arteries: Adequate opacification to the subsegmental level. No filling defect to suggest pulmonary embolism. Main PA 2.6 cm.
Heart and pericardium: Normal heart size. No pericardial effusion. RV/LV ratio < 1.
Mediastinum and hila: No lymphadenopathy. Normal thyroid.
Lungs and airways: Mild centrilobular emphysema, upper lobe predominant. 7 mm solid nodule in the right lower lobe posterior basal segment (series 4, image 212). No consolidation. Bibasal dependent atelectasis.
Pleura: No effusion or pneumothorax.
Upper abdomen: Unremarkable limited views.
Bones/soft tissues: Degenerative change thoracic spine.

IMPRESSION:
1. No pulmonary embolism.
2. Mild emphysema. Otherwise unremarkable.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: single solid 6-8 mm nodule in a high-risk (former smoker) patient needs CT at 6-12 months, even though it is only in the findings.

title: Ultrasound Abdomen
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND ABDOMEN COMPLETE
CLINICAL HISTORY: Deranged LFTs. Ex-smoker.
TECHNIQUE: Grey-scale and Doppler.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Liver: Increased echogenicity in keeping with steatosis. No focal lesion.
Gallbladder: Normal. CBD 4 mm.
Pancreas: Head and body normal.
Spleen: 11 cm.
Kidneys: Right 10.8 cm, left 11.2 cm. No hydronephrosis.
Aorta: Infrarenal aorta dilated to 3.2 cm AP outer-to-outer, fusiform; proximal aorta 2.0 cm.

IMPRESSION:
1. Hepatic steatosis.
2. 3.2 cm infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm.
rationale: SVS 2018/ACR vascular white paper: AAA 3.0-3.4 cm needs surveillance imaging every 3 years.

title: Cytopathology - EBUS-TBNA
text:
CYTOPATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: EBUS-TBNA, station 7 (subcarinal) lymph node, 4 passes; cell block
CLINICAL HISTORY: 2.1 cm right lower lobe mass, PET-avid subcarinal node (SUVmax 6.2).

MICROSCOPIC:
Smears are moderately cellular with abundant lymphocytes (adequate nodal sampling). Scattered small clusters of atypical epithelial cells with enlarged, hyperchromatic nuclei and occasional nucleoli are present, but are too few and too degenerated for definitive classification. Cell block contains insufficient lesional material for immunohistochemistry.

DIAGNOSIS:
Lymph node, station 7, EBUS-TBNA:
ATYPICAL CELLS PRESENT; malignancy cannot be excluded.

COMMENT: Correlation with imaging and repeat sampling (or sampling of the primary lesion) is recommended.
rationale: An atypical cytology result in a PET-avid node with a lung mass cannot exclude malignancy and requires notification and further sampling/specialist action.

title: CT Abdomen with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Right upper quadrant pain, normal ultrasound.
TECHNIQUE: Pancreatic and portal venous phases.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Pancreas: 2.0 x 1.7 cm thin-walled cystic lesion in the pancreatic tail, no enhancing nodule or solid component, main pancreatic duct 3 mm.
Liver: Two sub-centimetre hepatic hypodensities, too small to characterise, likely cysts.
Gallbladder: Normal.
Kidneys, spleen, adrenals: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
2.0 cm pancreatic tail cyst without worrisome features. MRI/MRCP surveillance in 1 year is recommended.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst white paper 2017: cyst 1.5-2.5 cm needs MRI/MRCP in 1 year.

title: Cytopathology - Thyroid FNA
text:
CYTOPATHOLOGY REPORT - THYROID FNA
SPECIMEN: Right thyroid nodule, 2.7 cm, TR3, ultrasound-guided FNA (3 passes)

ADEQUACY: Satisfactory for evaluation.

MICROSCOPIC:
Abundant thin colloid with numerous macrofollicular fragments and sheets of bland follicular cells with round nuclei. Scattered haemosiderin-laden macrophages. No papillary nuclear features.

DIAGNOSIS:
BENIGN (Bethesda category II) - consistent with a benign follicular nodule (adenomatoid/colloid nodule).
rationale: Bethesda II benign thyroid cytology has a very low malignancy risk and needs no urgent notification-and-referral loop.

title: Surgical Pathology - Anastomotic Biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Colon, ileocolic anastomosis, surveillance biopsies x4
CLINICAL HISTORY: History of resected adenocarcinoma of the ascending colon (pT3N0, right hemicolectomy 2023). Surveillance colonoscopy: mild erythema at the anastomosis.

MICROSCOPIC:
Fragments of colonic and small-bowel mucosa with mild active inflammation and reactive epithelial changes, including regenerative mucin depletion. Surface erosion with granulation tissue. No dysplasia.

DIAGNOSIS:
Ileocolic anastomosis, biopsies:
Mild active inflammation with reactive changes consistent with anastomotic ulceration.
NEGATIVE FOR DYSPLASIA AND MALIGNANCY. No evidence of recurrent adenocarcinoma.
rationale: The cancer history is prior; the current biopsy is negative for dysplasia and malignancy, so no new abnormal-pathology loop opens.

title: Screening Mammogram, Bilateral
text:
EXAM: SCREENING MAMMOGRAM, BILATERAL, 2D + DBT
CLINICAL HISTORY: Routine annual screening.
COMPARISON: 2025-05-28, 2024-05-21.
BREAST COMPOSITION: Scattered areas of fibroglandular density (b).

FINDINGS:
Stable bilateral coarse popcorn-type calcifications consistent with involuting fibroadenomas. Stable benign-appearing intramammary lymph node in the left upper outer quadrant. Vascular calcifications.
No suspicious mass, suspicious calcification or architectural distortion.

IMPRESSION:
Benign findings. No mammographic evidence of malignancy.
BI-RADS 2: Benign. Routine screening mammography recommended.
rationale: BI-RADS 2 is benign; only routine screening is recommended.

title: CT Abdomen without and with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN WITHOUT AND WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Follow-up of known pancreatitis; abdominal pain resolved.
TECHNIQUE: Unenhanced and portal venous phase.
COMPARISON: CT 2025-11-14.

FINDINGS:
Pancreas: Peripancreatic inflammatory change has resolved. No collection.
Kidneys: 1.9 cm well-defined homogeneous lesion in the left upper pole measuring 74 HU on the unenhanced images, no measurable enhancement. Additional 2.5 cm simple cyst right kidney (6 HU).
Liver: Mild steatosis.
Adrenals: No adrenal nodule.

IMPRESSION:
1. Resolved pancreatitis.
2. Left renal hyperattenuating cyst (homogeneous, ≥70 HU unenhanced) - Bosniak II; and right simple renal cyst. Both benign; no follow-up required.
3. Hepatic steatosis.
rationale: Bosniak 2019: homogeneous lesion >=70 HU on unenhanced CT is a class II hyperattenuating cyst needing no follow-up.

title: Ultrasound Abdomen
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND ABDOMEN (RUQ)
CLINICAL HISTORY: Dyspepsia.
TECHNIQUE: Real-time grey-scale and colour Doppler ultrasound.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Liver: Normal size and echotexture. No focal lesion.
Gallbladder: 8 mm sessile echogenic polyp arising from the fundal wall, non-mobile, without internal vascularity on colour Doppler. No shadowing stones. Wall not thickened.
CBD: 4 mm.
Pancreas: Partially obscured by bowel gas; visualised portions normal.
Kidneys: Normal.
Spleen: Normal.

IMPRESSION:
8 mm gallbladder polyp, no high-risk features. Recommend follow-up ultrasound in 6 months (SRU 2022), then at 12 and 24 months if stable.
rationale: SRU 2022 gallbladder polyp consensus: 7-9 mm polyp without risk features needs ultrasound at 6, 12 and 24 months; the report recommends US in 6 months.

title: CT Abdomen with Contrast - with Addendum
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Abdominal pain.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase CT abdomen and pelvis.
COMPARISON: None at time of initial report.

FINDINGS:
Liver: 2.2 cm hypodense lesion in segment IVb with peripheral nodular enhancement. No other liver lesion.
Gallbladder: Normal. Pancreas: Normal. Kidneys: Normal.
Bowel: Mild sigmoid diverticulosis.

IMPRESSION:
2.2 cm hepatic lesion, likely haemangioma. Recommend MRI liver for confirmation.

ADDENDUM (2026-07-03):
Outside MRI abdomen from 2023-05-10 has since been obtained and reviewed. The segment IVb lesion was characterised as a typical haemangioma on that study (2.2 cm) and is unchanged in size over 3 years. No MRI is required; the recommendation above is withdrawn.
rationale: Addendum withdraws the MRI recommendation: prior MRI confirms a stable typical haemangioma, which needs no follow-up (ACR liver white paper).

title: Pelvic Ultrasound (Transvaginal)
text:
EXAM: ULTRASOUND PELVIS, TRANSABDOMINAL AND TRANSVAGINAL
CLINICAL HISTORY: Left pelvic pain, LMP 2026-04-12.
TECHNIQUE: TA and TV grey-scale with colour Doppler.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Uterus: Anteverted, 7.8 cm, normal myometrium. Endometrium 9 mm, secretory.
Right ovary: Normal, with follicles.
Left ovary: 5.6 x 4.9 cm unilocular cyst with reticular (lace-like) internal echoes and a retracting clot, no internal vascularity on colour Doppler, consistent with a haemorrhagic cyst.
Free fluid: Small amount in the pouch of Douglas.

IMPRESSION:
5.6 cm left haemorrhagic ovarian cyst (O-RADS US 2). Given size >5 cm, recommend follow-up pelvic ultrasound in 8-12 weeks, ideally in the follicular phase (days 3-10), to confirm resolution.
rationale: O-RADS US: haemorrhagic cyst >5 cm in a premenopausal patient warrants follow-up ultrasound in 8-12 weeks; the report recommends it firmly.

title: CT Chest - Nodule Follow-up
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: 10 mm left lower lobe nodule found 2026-01; PET/CT and biopsy since.
TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT chest.
COMPARISON: CT chest 2026-01-08. PET/CT 2026-03-02.

FINDINGS:
The left lower lobe nodule measures 10 mm (series 3, image 150), unchanged. It contains internal fat (-60 HU) and popcorn calcification, better seen on the current thin sections.
PET/CT performed 3/2 showed no FDG uptake in the nodule (SUVmax below mediastinal blood pool). CT-guided core biopsy on 2026-03-09 showed pulmonary hamartoma (pathology report S26-01877).
No new nodules. No lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:
Stable 10 mm left lower lobe nodule, biopsy-proven hamartoma with concordant imaging features. Work-up is complete; no further imaging follow-up is needed.
rationale: The Fleischner work-up (PET/CT and tissue sampling) is already completed with a benign hamartoma diagnosis.

title: Surgical Pathology - Breast Core Biopsy with Addendum
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Right breast, 7 o'clock, US-guided core biopsy (14G x 4)
CLINICAL HISTORY: BI-RADS 4B mass, 9 mm.

PRELIMINARY DIAGNOSIS (2026-05-12):
Right breast 7 o'clock, core biopsy: Intraductal epithelial proliferation; atypia cannot be excluded on H&E. Immunohistochemistry pending. Final report to follow.

ADDENDUM - FINAL DIAGNOSIS (2026-05-15):
CK5/6 shows a heterogeneous mosaic staining pattern and ER is heterogeneous within the proliferation, supporting usual ductal hyperplasia. Background shows a fibroadenoma with stromal and epithelial components accounting for the mass.
FINAL DIAGNOSIS: FIBROADENOMA WITH USUAL DUCTAL HYPERPLASIA. No atypia. NEGATIVE FOR MALIGNANCY.
Radiologic-pathologic correlation: concordant benign (discussed with breast radiology 2026-05-15).
rationale: The addendum supersedes the preliminary 'atypia cannot be excluded' with a concordant benign fibroadenoma; no abnormal-pathology loop remains.

title: MRI Brain with and without Contrast
text:
EXAM: MRI BRAIN WITH AND WITHOUT GADOLINIUM
CLINICAL HISTORY: Migraine with aura, change in pattern.
TECHNIQUE: Sagittal T1, axial T2/FLAIR/DWI/SWI, post-contrast 3D T1.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Brain parenchyma: A few punctate nonspecific T2/FLAIR hyperintensities in the frontal subcortical white matter, within normal limits for age and commonly seen in migraineurs. No restricted diffusion. No haemorrhage. No abnormal enhancement.
Pituitary: 5 mm hypoenhancing lesion in the right side of the adenohypophysis, consistent with a microadenoma. No mass effect on the optic chiasm. Stalk midline.
Ventricles and extra-axial spaces: Normal.
Orbits and sinuses: Mild mucosal thickening in the maxillary sinuses.

IMPRESSION:
1. No acute intracranial abnormality. A few nonspecific white matter foci, likely migraine related.
2. Incidental 5 mm pituitary microadenoma. Endocrine evaluation and follow-up imaging could be considered if clinically indicated, at the discretion of the referring clinician.
rationale: ACR incidental pituitary guidance: an asymptomatic microadenoma <10 mm needs no imaging follow-up, and the advice is explicitly conditional.

title: CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis Staging
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST, ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST (STAGING)
CLINICAL HISTORY: Sigmoid adenocarcinoma, post-operative restaging; on adjuvant chemotherapy.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase CT CAP (routine oncology protocol, not PE-timed).
COMPARISON: CT CAP 2026-02-14.

FINDINGS:
Chest: Filling defect within a right lower lobe segmental pulmonary artery (series 2, image 140), new. No right heart strain. No pulmonary nodules. No effusion.
Abdomen/Pelvis: Post sigmoid colectomy, anastomosis unremarkable. No liver metastases. New 1.3 cm left adrenal nodule (32 HU), not present on the prior CT. No adenopathy. No ascites.
Bones: No suspicious lesion.

IMPRESSION:
1. Incidental right lower lobe segmental pulmonary embolus.
2. New 1.3 cm left adrenal nodule, indeterminate; metastasis to be excluded.
3. No other evidence of recurrent disease.
rationale: An incidental segmental PE is a critical finding with no documented communication, and a new adrenal nodule >=1 cm in a patient with cancer needs specialist work-up (ACR 2017).

title: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Abdominal bloating, altered bowel habit.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase; delayed images not obtained.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Liver: Normal.
Pancreas: Normal.
Spleen: Normal.
Adrenals: Right adrenal 2.8 x 2.2 cm well-circumscribed nodule, 38 HU on portal venous phase. Left adrenal normal.
Kidneys: Normal.
Bowel: Normal calibre, no wall thickening. Normal appendix.
Pelvis: Uterus and adnexa unremarkable.
Nodes: None enlarged.

IMPRESSION:
1. No cause for bloating identified.
2. Indeterminate 2.8 cm right adrenal nodule. Recommend dedicated adrenal protocol CT (unenhanced and washout) or chemical-shift MRI for characterisation, and biochemical evaluation.
rationale: ACR adrenal white paper 2017: indeterminate 2-4 cm adrenal nodule without cancer history needs adrenal CT or MRI characterisation.

title: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITH IV CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Left flank pain, haematuria. Query stone.
TECHNIQUE: Portal venous phase CT abdomen and pelvis.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
LOWER CHEST: Clear.
LIVER: Normal size and attenuation. No focal lesion.
GALLBLADDER/BILIARY: Normal.
PANCREAS: Normal.
SPLEEN: Normal.
ADRENALS: Right adrenal normal. 1.6 cm left adrenal nodule measuring 42 HU on this portal venous phase study (series 3, image 51).
KIDNEYS/URETERS: 4 mm calculus at the left vesicoureteric junction with mild left hydroureteronephrosis and perinephric stranding. Right kidney normal.
BLADDER: Unremarkable.
BOWEL: Normal.
VESSELS/NODES: Normal.
BONES: No suspicious lesion.

IMPRESSION:
4 mm obstructing left VUJ calculus with mild hydronephrosis. Otherwise unremarkable.
rationale: ACR adrenal white paper 2017: indeterminate 1-2 cm adrenal nodule without prior imaging or cancer history needs adrenal CT/MRI at 12 months, even though the impression omits it.

title: Surgical Pathology - Oesophageal Biopsies
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN:
A. Oesophagus, 32-35 cm, Barrett's segment, quadrantic biopsies
B. Oesophagus, 34 cm, nodular area, biopsy
CLINICAL HISTORY: Barrett's surveillance (C4M5). Nodular area at 34 cm.

MICROSCOPIC:
A. Columnar mucosa with goblet cells (intestinal metaplasia). No dysplasia.
B. Intestinal metaplasia with HIGH-GRADE DYSPLASIA: crowded glands with loss of polarity, marked nuclear pleomorphism and full-thickness stratification extending to the surface. No invasion identified in this superficial sample. Reviewed and agreed by a second GI pathologist (Dr. M. Varga).

DIAGNOSIS:
A. Barrett's oesophagus (intestinal metaplasia), negative for dysplasia.
B. Barrett's oesophagus with HIGH-GRADE DYSPLASIA. Invasive carcinoma cannot be assessed in this superficial biopsy.

Recommend referral to a Barrett's endoscopic therapy centre.
rationale: BSG/ACG Barrett guidelines: high-grade dysplasia confirmed by a second pathologist requires notification and referral for endoscopic therapy; part A being negative does not change this.

title: Surgical Pathology - Renal Mass Core Biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Left kidney, lower pole mass, CT-guided core biopsy (18G x 3)
CLINICAL HISTORY: 3.1 cm enhancing renal mass (cT1a), patient considering ablation.

MICROSCOPIC:
Cores show nests of tumour cells with clear cytoplasm and distinct cell membranes separated by a delicate arborising vascular network. Nuclei are small with inconspicuous nucleoli at 400x (WHO/ISUP grade 2). Immunohistochemistry: CA-IX diffuse membranous (box-like) positive, CD10 positive, CK7 negative, AMACR negative.

DIAGNOSIS:
Kidney, left, lower pole mass, core biopsy:
RENAL CELL CARCINOMA, CLEAR CELL TYPE, WHO/ISUP grade 2 (provisional on core).
rationale: Biopsy-proven clear cell renal cell carcinoma requires notification and urology/oncology referral.

title: CT Chest without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Dysphagia, reflux. Ex-smoker.
TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT chest, 1.25 mm slices.
COMPARISON: None available.

FINDINGS:
Lungs: 4 mm pure ground-glass nodule in the left upper lobe (series 2, image 87). No solid nodule. Mild dependent atelectasis.
Mediastinum: Moderate sliding hiatal hernia with intrathoracic stomach fundus. Oesophagus otherwise unremarkable. No lymphadenopathy.
Heart: Normal size.
Pleura: No effusion.
Upper abdomen: Cholelithiasis without wall thickening.
Bones: Mild degenerative change.

IMPRESSION:
1. Moderate hiatal hernia, which may explain the symptoms.
2. 4 mm ground-glass nodule left upper lobe: no routine follow-up is required (Fleischner 2017, GGN <6 mm).
3. Incidental cholelithiasis.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: ground-glass nodule <6 mm needs no routine follow-up; hiatal hernia and gallstones are not follow-up obligations.

title: CT Abdomen without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Back pain. Patient demographics incomplete (transfer from outside facility).
TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Aorta: Infrarenal abdominal aortic aneurysm, maximal diameter 5.8 cm, with peripheral mural calcification. No periaortic fat stranding, high-attenuation crescent or retroperitoneal haematoma.
Spine: Degenerative disc disease L4-5 and L5-S1 with moderate canal narrowing. No fracture.
Kidneys: No calculus or hydronephrosis.
Bowel: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. 5.8 cm infrarenal AAA without CT signs of rupture or impending rupture. Recommend urgent outpatient vascular surgery referral.
2. Lumbar degenerative disease.
rationale: SVS 2018: AAA >=5.5 cm meets the repair threshold regardless of sex and needs vascular surgery referral.

title: CT Chest with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Haemoptysis x1, current smoker. Bronchoscopy normal.
TECHNIQUE: Contrast-enhanced CT chest, thin-section reformats.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Lungs: 7 mm smooth, lentiform solid nodule abutting the right major fissure (series 4, image 120), triangular in the sagittal plane with a thin septal attachment, typical of an intrapulmonary lymph node (perifissural nodule). No other nodules. Mild emphysema.
Airways: Patent central airways; no endobronchial lesion.
Mediastinum and hila: No lymphadenopathy.
Pleura: Normal.
Upper abdomen: No adrenal nodule.

IMPRESSION:
1. No cause for haemoptysis identified. No endobronchial lesion.
2. 7 mm perifissural nodule with typical morphology of an intrapulmonary lymph node; per Fleischner 2017 no follow-up is required.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: perifissural nodules with typical lymph-node morphology need no follow-up even when >6 mm.

title: Surgical Pathology - Colon Biopsy
text:
SURGICAL PATHOLOGY REPORT
SPECIMEN: Colon, sigmoid, 25 cm from anal verge, mass - endoscopic biopsies (x6)
CLINICAL HISTORY: Iron deficiency anaemia. Colonoscopy: circumferential friable sigmoid mass.

GROSS DESCRIPTION:
Received in formalin labelled with the patient's name and "sigmoid mass" are six tan-pink soft tissue fragments, 0.2 to 0.5 cm. Entirely submitted in cassette A1.

MICROSCOPIC DESCRIPTION:
Sections show colonic mucosa infiltrated by irregular, complex glands lined by markedly atypical columnar cells with dirty necrosis, invading into the submucosa with desmoplastic stroma.

DIAGNOSIS:
Colon, sigmoid mass, biopsy:
- INVASIVE ADENOCARCINOMA, moderately differentiated.
- Mismatch repair immunohistochemistry to follow in an addendum.
rationale: New invasive colorectal adenocarcinoma requires patient notification and specialist (colorectal/oncology) referral.

title: CT Chest without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST NON-CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Pre-operative assessment before hip arthroplasty; abnormal CXR. Smoking history not provided.
TECHNIQUE: Non-contrast CT chest, 1.25 rnm sections.
COMPARISON: CXR 2026-06-22.

FINDINGS:
LUNGS: Solid nodule in the left upper lobe lingular segrnent measuring 1O rnm (series 2, irnage 77), corresponding to the radiographic opacity. Smooth margins. No calcification. No other nodules.
PLEURA: Small left pleural plaque, calcified.
MEDIASTINUM: No lymphadenopathy.
UPPER ABDOMEN: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1O rnm solid lingular nodule. Recommend CT chest in 3 months, or PET/CT, per Fleischner 2017 (risk unknown, managed as high risk).
Calcified pleural plaque, likely prior asbestos exposure.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid nodule >8 mm (10 mm, OCR-garbled) needs CT at 3 months, PET/CT or sampling; unknown smoking history is managed as high risk.

title: Low-Dose CT Lung Cancer Screening
text:
EXAM: CT LUNG SCREENING (LOW DOSE)
CLINICAL HISTORY: Baseline screening, current smoker 60 pack-years.
TECHNIQUE: Low-dose non-contrast CT chest.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
1. Solid nodule left upper lobe, 16 mm mean diameter (series 2, image 41), lobulated margins.
2. Small paraseptal emphysema.
3. Severe coronary artery calcification.
4. No mediastinal or hilar adenopathy by size criteria.

IMPRESSION:
Dominant left upper lobe nodule as above.
Other findings: coronary calcification (S).

LUNG-RADS CATEGORY: 4B
MANAGEMENT RECOMMENDATION: Diagnostic chest CT with or without contrast, PET/CT and/or tissue sampling depending on probability of malignancy and comorbidities. Referral to the lung nodule MDT recommended.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid nodule >=15 mm is category 4B, requiring diagnostic work-up.

title: CT Abdomen without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITHOUT CONTRAST (RENAL STONE PROTOCOL)
CLINICAL HISTORY: Right renal colic.
TECHNIQUE: Low-dose non-contrast CT.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Kidneys: 3 mm non-obstructing right lower pole calculus. No hydronephrosis. No ureteric calculus.
Adrenals: 2.1 cm right adrenal nodule with attenuation of -5 HU on this unenhanced study, diagnostic of a lipid-rich adenoma. Left adrenal normal.
Liver, spleen, pancreas: Unremarkable for unenhanced technique.
Bowel: Diverticulosis without diverticulitis.
Bladder: Normal.

IMPRESSION:
1. 3 mm non-obstructing right renal calculus; no obstruction.
2. 2.1 cm right adrenal adenoma (-5 HU). No imaging follow-up required.
3. Colonic diverticulosis.
rationale: ACR adrenal white paper 2017: a nodule <=10 HU on unenhanced CT is a lipid-rich adenoma and needs no imaging follow-up.

title: CT Chest/Abdomen Staging
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST AND ABDOMEN WITH CONTRAST - STAGING
CLINICAL HISTORY: Newly diagnosed non-small cell lung carcinoma (left upper lobe, biopsy-proven adenocarcinoma). Staging.
TECHNIQUE: Contrast-enhanced CT chest and abdomen.
COMPARISON: CT chest 2026-03-20.

FINDINGS:
CHEST: Known 3.2 cm left upper lobe mass, unchanged. Enlarged left hilar node 13 mm short axis. No contralateral nodes. No pleural effusion.
ABDOMEN:
- Liver: No focal lesion.
- Adrenals: 1.4 cm right adrenal nodule, 34 HU on portal venous phase, new compared with the abdominal coverage of 2024 CT (not seen). Left adrenal normal.
- Kidneys, pancreas, spleen: Unremarkable.
- Bones: No suspicious lesion.

IMPRESSION:
1. Known left upper lobe adenocarcinoma with ipsilateral hilar nodal disease.
2. New 1.4 cm right adrenal nodule, indeterminate; metastasis cannot be excluded in this context.
rationale: ACR adrenal white paper 2017: an adrenal nodule >=1 cm in a patient with known malignancy needs PET/CT, biopsy or specialist review.

title: CT Abdomen and Pelvis with Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT ABDOMEN/PELVIS WITH CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Postmenopausal bleeding; endometrial thickening on TVUS.
TECHNIQUE: Single portal venous phase.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Pelvis: Bulky uterus with an ill-defined endometrial cavity; no extra-uterine extension. Ovaries normal. No pelvic adenopathy.
Kidneys: 1.8 cm homogeneous solid-appearing lesion in the right kidney interpolar region, 48 HU on portal venous phase only; cannot be characterised on this single-phase examination. No hydronephrosis.
Liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenals: Normal.
Peritoneum: No ascites.

IMPRESSION:
1. Uterine findings as above; correlate with planned hysteroscopic biopsy.
2. Indeterminate 1.8 cm right renal lesion. Recommend renal mass protocol MRI.
rationale: ACR renal white paper 2018/Bosniak 2019: homogeneous lesion >30 HU on single portal venous phase is indeterminate and needs renal mass protocol CT/MRI.

title: CT Chest without Contrast
text:
EXAM: CT CHEST WITHOUT CONTRAST
CLINICAL HISTORY: Follow-up of interstitial changes seen on outside CXR. Never smoker.
TECHNIQUE: Volumetric non-contrast CT chest, 1 mm reconstructions, prone images added.
COMPARISON: None.

FINDINGS:
Lungs: No interstitial lung disease; previously queried changes reflect dependent atelectasis, clearing on prone images. 8 mm pure ground-glass nodule in the right upper lobe anterior segment (series 5, image 61). No solid component. No other nodule.
Airways: Patent.
Mediastinum: No lymphadenopathy.
Pleura: Normal.
Upper abdomen: Unremarkable.

IMPRESSION:
1. No interstitial lung disease.
2. 8 mm pure ground-glass nodule right upper lobe. Recommend CT chest in 6-12 months to confirm persistence (Fleischner 2017), then every 2 years until 5 years if unchanged.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: single pure ground-glass nodule >=6 mm needs CT at 6-12 months.

title: Low-Dose CT Lung Cancer Screening
text:
EXAM: LOW-DOSE CT CHEST FOR LUNG CANCER SCREENING (ANNUAL)
CLINICAL HISTORY: 62 y/o current smoker, 40 pack-years. Annual screening.
TECHNIQUE: Low-dose non-contrast CT, CTDIvol 1.1 mGy, 1 mm reconstructions.
COMPARISON: LDCT 2025-01-09.

FINDINGS:
Lung nodules: 3 mm solid nodule right lower lobe (series 3, image 180), new since prior. 5 mm solid nodule left upper lobe, unchanged since 2024.
Lungs: Mild centrilobular emphysema.
Other: Mild coronary artery calcification. No lymphadenopathy. No pleural effusion.

IMPRESSION:
LUNG-RADS CATEGORY 2 - Benign appearance or behaviour (new nodule <4 mm; stable 5 mm nodule).
Continue annual screening.
S modifier: mild coronary artery calcification; cardiovascular risk assessment per primary care.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022 category 2 (new nodule <4 mm mean diameter) means routine annual screening only; no short-interval follow-up.

title: Chest CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT, enhanced
임상정보: 62세 남자, 만성기침 r/o bronchiectasis. 과거 흡연자 (30 pack-years, 5년 전 금연).
비교: 없음

판독소견:
RLL superior segment에 7 mm 크기의 solid nodule이 있습니다. 경계는 비교적 smooth 하며 석회화나 지방은 보이지 않습니다.
그 외 폐실질에 특이 소견 없습니다. 기관지확장증 소견은 뚜렷하지 않습니다.
종격동 및 폐문 림프절 비대 없습니다. 흉수 없습니다.

결론:
1. RLL 7 mm solid nodule, indeterminate.
2. No evidence of bronchiectasis.

권고:
Fleischner 2017 고위험군 기준 6-12개월 후 추적 흉부 CT 권함.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: single solid 6-8 mm nodule in a high-risk patient needs CT at 6-12 months.

title: Chest CT (non-enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT, non-enhanced
임상정보: 건강검진, 비흡연자
비교: 없음

판독소견:
LUL apicoposterior segment에 4 mm solid nodule 1개 있습니다.
그 외 폐야는 깨끗합니다. 종격동 림프절 비대 없음. 흉막삼출 없음.
갑상선, 상복부 촬영범위 내 특이소견 없음.

결론:
LUL 4 mm solid nodule, probably benign.

권고:
Fleischner 2017 저위험군, 6 mm 미만 → 추적검사 불필요.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: solid nodule <6 mm in a low-risk patient needs no routine follow-up.

title: Low-dose chest CT for lung cancer screening
text:
검사명: LDCT (폐암검진)
임상정보: 국가폐암검진, 현재 흡연 40 갑년
비교: 없음 (baseline screening)

판독소견:
RUL anterior segment에 mean diameter 10.4 mm solid nodule 있습니다. 경계 lobulated, spiculation 없음.
그 외 새로운 결절 없습니다. 경도의 centrilobular emphysema.
관상동맥 석회화 mild.

결론:
RUL 10.4 mm solid nodule.
Lung-RADS category 4A.

권고:
3개월 후 LDCT 권함 (or PET/CT 고려).
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid nodule 8 to <15 mm is category 4A, managed by 3-month LDCT.

title: Low-dose chest CT for lung cancer screening
text:
검사명: LDCT (폐암검진)
임상정보: 폐암검진 2년차. 과거흡연자.
비교: 2025-01-18 LDCT

판독소견:
LLL에 4 mm solid nodule, 이전 검사와 비교하여 변화 없습니다.
RML에 3 mm 결절 역시 변화 없음.
새로 생긴 결절 없습니다. 기관지벽 비후 경미.

결론:
Stable small solid nodules.
Lung-RADS category 2 (benign appearance or behavior).

권고:
12개월 후 정기 LDCT 검진.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022 category 2 returns to routine annual screening, which no catalogue rule tracks as a follow-up obligation.

title: Low-dose chest CT for lung cancer screening
text:
검사명: 저선량 흉부 CT (LDCT)
임상정보: 폐암검진 baseline, 과거흡연 25 PY
비교: 없음

판독소견:
LLL lateral basal segment에 mean diameter 6.8 mm solid nodule 1개.
석회화 없음. 그 외 결절 없음.
폐기종 소견 없음. 림프절 비대 없음.

결론:
1. LLL 6.8 mm solid nodule - Lung-RADS 3 (probably benign).

권고:
6개월 후 LDCT 요망.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: baseline solid nodule 6 to <8 mm is category 3, needing 6-month LDCT.

title: Abdomen-pelvis CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: Abdomen-Pelvis CT, enhanced (portal phase)
임상정보: 우하복부 통증, r/o appendicitis
비교: 없음

판독소견:
충수는 정상 굵기이며 주변 지방침윤 없습니다.
우측 부신에 1.5 cm 크기의 nodule, portal phase에서 약 38 HU. 이전 영상 없음.
간, 담낭, 췌장, 비장 특이소견 없음. 양측 신장 정상.
복수 없음.

결론:
1. No evidence of acute appendicitis.
2. 그 외 특이 소견 없음.
rationale: ACR adrenal white paper: indeterminate 1-2 cm adrenal nodule without prior imaging needs adrenal CT/MRI in 12 months.

title: Abdomen CT (adrenal protocol)
text:
검사명: Adrenal protocol CT (unenhanced + delayed)
임상정보: 타병원 CT상 incidental adrenal nodule
비교: 2026-01-08 외부 CT

판독소견:
좌측 부신에 2.2 cm 크기의 oval nodule, unenhanced attenuation -5 HU.
균질하며 경계 명확함. 우측 부신 정상.

결론:
Lt. adrenal 2.2 cm lipid-rich adenoma.

권고:
영상 추적검사 불필요. 내분비 기능검사는 임상적으로 판단.
rationale: ACR adrenal white paper: nodule with unenhanced attenuation <=10 HU is a lipid-rich adenoma needing no imaging follow-up.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text:
검사명: Thyroid US
임상정보: 건강검진 갑상선 결절
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Rt. lobe mid portion에 1.8 x 1.2 x 1.1 cm solid nodule.
hypoechoic, wider-than-tall, smooth margin, 미세석회화 없음.
ACR TI-RADS: composition solid 2 + hypoechoic 2 + shape 0 + margin 0 + echogenic foci 0 = 4 points, TR4.
(K-TIRADS 4)
Lt. lobe에 3 mm cyst. 경부 림프절 특이소견 없음.

결론:
Rt. thyroid 1.8 cm nodule, ACR TI-RADS TR4.

권고:
FNA 권함.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR4 nodule >=1.5 cm meets FNA criteria.

title: Thyroid ultrasound
text:
검사명: Thyroid US
임상정보: 갑상선결절 확인
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Lt. lobe lower pole에 1.2 cm mixed cystic and solid nodule (predominantly solid), isoechoic, wider-than-tall, smooth margin, echogenic foci 없음.
ACR TI-RADS 3 points (TR3).
그 외 특이 결절 없음. 경부 림프절 정상.

결론:
Lt. thyroid 1.2 cm nodule, TR3.

권고:
TR3 기준 FNA (2.5 cm 이상) 및 추적검사 (1.5 cm 이상) 기준 미만으로 추가 검사 불필요.
rationale: ACR TI-RADS: TR3 nodule <1.5 cm needs neither FNA nor ultrasound follow-up.

title: Abdomen-pelvis CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: APCT, enhanced
임상정보: 요로결석 의심, 측복부 통증
비교: 없음

판독소견:
좌측 UVJ에 4 mm stone 및 mild hydronephrosis.
신장하부 복부대동맥이 최대 직경 4.2 cm로 fusiform aneurysmal dilatation, 벽재성 혈전 동반. 주위 지방침윤 없음.
그 외 특이 소견 없음.

결론:
1. Lt. UVJ 4 mm stone with mild hydronephrosis.
2. Infrarenal AAA, 4.2 cm.

권고:
AAA에 대해 혈관외과 상담 및 1년 후 추적 영상 권함.
rationale: SVS 2018 / ACR vascular: AAA 4.0-4.4 cm needs surveillance imaging at 12 months.

title: Abdomen CT angiography
text:
검사명: Abdominal aorta CTA
임상정보: AAA 추적관찰
비교: 2025-02-20 CTA (4.6 cm)

판독소견:
신장하부 복부대동맥류 최대 직경 5.2 cm (이전 4.6 cm)로 증가.
파열 소견이나 주변 혈종 없음. 장골동맥 정상 범위.

결론:
Infrarenal AAA, 5.2 cm, interval growth (+0.6 cm/1yr). No rupture.

권고:
혈관외과 협진 요망.
rationale: SVS 2018: AAA >=5.0 cm in a woman is at the repair threshold and needs vascular surgery referral.

title: Bilateral screening mammography
text:
검사명: Mammography, both (screening)
임상정보: 유방암 검진
비교: 2024-03-05

판독소견:
Breast composition: c (heterogeneously dense).
Lt. breast UOQ, posterior depth에 새로 생긴 fine pleomorphic calcifications, segmental distribution, 약 1.5 cm 범위.
Rt. breast 특이소견 없음. 액와 림프절 정상.

결론:
Lt. UOQ new fine pleomorphic calcifications, segmental.
BI-RADS category 4B (moderate suspicion for malignancy).

권고:
Stereotactic biopsy 권함.
rationale: BI-RADS 5th ed.: category 4 requires tissue diagnosis.

title: Breast ultrasound
text:
검사명: Breast US, both
임상정보: Rt. breast palpable mass
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Rt. breast 10시, FN 3 cm에 0.9 cm oval, circumscribed, parallel, hypoechoic mass. posterior features 없음. 혈류 없음.
Lt. breast 특이소견 없음. 양측 액와 림프절 정상.

결론:
Rt. 10시 0.9 cm probably benign mass (fibroadenoma 가능성).
BI-RADS category 3.

권고:
6개월 후 추적 유방초음파 권함.
rationale: BI-RADS 3 has no catalogue rule; the explicit 6-month follow-up breast ultrasound recommendation is tracked as R032.

title: Bilateral screening mammography
text:
검사명: Mammography, both (screening)
임상정보: 국가암검진
비교: 2024-02-28

판독소견:
Breast composition: b (scattered fibroglandular).
종괴, 구조왜곡, 의심 석회화 없습니다.

결론:
Negative.
BI-RADS category 1.

권고:
정기 검진.
rationale: BI-RADS 1 needs only routine screening.

title: Brain CT (non-enhanced)
text:
검사명: Brain CT, non-enhanced (응급)
임상정보: 갑자기 발생한 좌측 위약감, 의식저하. 항응고제(warfarin) 복용.
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Rt. basal ganglia에 약 4.5 x 3.2 cm acute intracerebral hemorrhage, 주변 부종 동반.
뇌실내 출혈 동반 (Rt. lateral ventricle).
Midline shift 약 6 mm to the left.
수두증 소견은 아직 뚜렷하지 않음.

결론:
1. Rt. basal ganglia acute ICH (~30 mL) with IVH and 6 mm midline shift.

※ 응급실 김OO 전공의에게 판독 직후 (21:42) 전화로 결과 전달함.
rationale: ACR communication practice parameter: acute intracranial haemorrhage is a critical finding requiring direct communication; here the call is documented.

title: Chest CT pulmonary angiography
text:
검사명: Chest CT, PE protocol
임상정보: 난소암 항암치료 중, 호흡곤란 및 빈맥
비교: 2026-01-05 Chest CT

판독소견:
양측 폐동맥 (Rt. interlobar, Lt. lower lobar 및 segmental branches)에 다수의 filling defect - acute pulmonary thromboembolism.
RV/LV ratio 1.1, interventricular septum 편평화 경미.
소량의 우측 흉수. 이전 검사 대비 폐 전이 소견 없음.

결론:
1. Bilateral acute pulmonary thromboembolism with mild RV strain.
2. Small Rt. pleural effusion.
rationale: ACR communication practice parameter: acute PE is a critical finding requiring direct clinician communication, which is not documented here.

title: Gastric endoscopic biopsy
text:
검체: Stomach, antrum, lesser curvature, endoscopic biopsy (3 pieces)
임상정보: EGD상 2.5 cm ulcerative lesion, r/o EGC

육안소견: 3 pieces of tan tissue, 0.2-0.4 cm.

현미경소견 및 진단:
Stomach, antrum, endoscopic biopsy:
  Adenocarcinoma, moderately differentiated (tubular type).
  Lauren classification: intestinal type.

추가: H. pylori (Giemsa): positive.
rationale: Abnormal (malignant) pathology requires patient notification and specialist referral.

title: Gastric endoscopic biopsy
text:
검체: Stomach, body, endoscopic biopsy (2 pieces)
임상정보: 건강검진 EGD, erythematous mucosa

진단:
Stomach, body, endoscopic biopsy:
  Chronic superficial gastritis, mild.
  No intestinal metaplasia.
  No dysplasia or malignancy.
  H. pylori (Giemsa): negative.
rationale: Benign chronic gastritis without dysplasia requires no further action.

title: Thyroid fine-needle aspiration cytology
text:
검체: Thyroid, right lobe, US-guided FNA
임상정보: Rt. 1.8 cm nodule, TI-RADS TR4

세포소견:
세포충실도 적절. 소수의 여포세포 군집에서 핵 비대, 핵막 불규칙 및 경미한 핵투명화(nuclear clearing)가 국소적으로 관찰되나 유두암종 진단에는 불충분함.

진단:
Thyroid, right, FNA:
  Atypia of undetermined significance (AUS) with nuclear atypia.
  The Bethesda System category III.

참고: 반복 FNA 또는 분자검사를 고려하십시오.
rationale: Bethesda III (AUS) is an indeterminate abnormal cytology result requiring notification and specialist follow-up (repeat FNA or molecular testing).

title: Breast core needle biopsy
text:
검체: Breast, left, 2시, US-guided core needle biopsy (14G x 4)
임상정보: BI-RADS 4A mass 1.3 cm

진단:
Breast, left, 2 o'clock, core biopsy:
  Fibroadenoma.
  No atypia or malignancy.

참고: 영상소견과 일치 (concordant).
rationale: Benign concordant core biopsy (fibroadenoma) completes the BI-RADS 4A work-up; no abnormal pathology action needed.

title: Abdomen CT (kidney protocol)
text:
검사명: Kidney CT (unenhanced + nephrographic phase)
임상정보: 초음파상 Lt. renal cyst, complex
비교: 2026-02-27 Kidney US

판독소견:
Lt. kidney upper pole에 3.1 cm cystic lesion.
다수의 얇은 격막(>3개, smooth, 2 mm 이하) 및 경미한 평활한 벽 비후 (3 mm), 측정가능한 조영증강 없음. 결절성 증강 없음.
Rt. kidney 정상.

결론:
Lt. renal cystic mass, Bosniak class IIF (v2019).

권고:
6개월 후 renal mass protocol CT 또는 MRI 추적 권함.
rationale: Bosniak v2019: class IIF cyst needs follow-up renal CT/MRI at 6 months.

title: Abdomen ultrasound
text:
검사명: Abdomen US
임상정보: 건강검진
비교: 2025-03-22 US

판독소견:
간: 경도의 지방간.
담낭: 2 mm polyp 1개.
Rt. kidney: 2.3 cm anechoic cyst, thin wall, posterior enhancement, 격막이나 고형성분 없음. 이전 검사와 크기 동일.
췌장, 비장 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Mild fatty liver.
2. Rt. renal simple cyst (Bosniak I), stable.
3. Tiny GB polyp.

권고:
추적검사 불필요.
rationale: Bosniak v2019 class I simple cyst needs no follow-up; a 2 mm gallbladder polyp also needs none.

title: Abdomen MRI with MRCP
text:
검사명: Pancreas MRI with MRCP
임상정보: CT상 incidental pancreatic cyst
비교: 2026-03-02 APCT

판독소견:
췌장 체부에 1.8 cm unilocular cystic lesion, 주췌관과 연결 의심 (branch-duct IPMN 가능성).
벽재성 결절이나 증강되는 고형성분 없음. 주췌관 직경 2.5 mm. 벽 비후 없음.

결론:
Pancreatic body 1.8 cm cyst, probable BD-IPMN, no worrisome features.

권고:
1년 후 MRI/MRCP 추적 권함.
rationale: ACR pancreatic cyst white paper: 1.5-2.5 cm cyst without worrisome features needs MRI/MRCP in 1 year.

title: Abdomen-pelvis CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: APCT, enhanced (pancreas protocol)
임상정보: 체중감소, 상복부 불편감
비교: 2024-05-10 APCT (cyst 1.2 cm)

판독소견:
췌장 두부에 2.0 cm multilocular cystic lesion (이전 1.2 cm).
주췌관 직경 8 mm로 확장 (이전 4 mm).
낭종 내부 5 mm enhancing mural nodule 의심.
총담관 확장 없음. 간전이 소견 없음.

결론:
Pancreatic head cystic lesion with MPD dilatation (8 mm) and enhancing mural nodule - IPMN with worrisome features/high-risk stigmata 의심.

권고:
EUS 및 췌장 전문의 협진 요망.
rationale: ACR / Fukuoka: pancreatic cyst with main duct >=7 mm and an enhancing mural nodule needs EUS and pancreas specialist evaluation.

title: Liver dynamic CT
text:
검사명: Liver dynamic CT (4-phase)
임상정보: 초음파상 간 결절, r/o hemangioma
비교: 2026-03-20 Abdomen US

판독소견:
S6에 2.4 cm lesion, arterial phase에서 peripheral nodular discontinuous enhancement, portal 및 delayed phase에서 centripetal fill-in. 혈관과 동일한 enhancement.
그 외 간 실질 정상. 간경변 소견 없음.

결론:
S6 2.4 cm hepatic hemangioma, typical.

권고:
추가 영상검사 불필요.
rationale: A typical hepatic hemangioma on multiphase CT in a non-cirrhotic patient needs no follow-up (ACR liver incidental findings).

title: Liver ultrasound (HCC surveillance)
text:
검사명: Liver US
임상정보: 만성 B형간염, 간경변. HCC surveillance.
비교: 2025-10-07 Liver US (결절 없음)

판독소견:
간 표면 결절성, 실질 거친 에코 - 간경변.
S8에 새로 생긴 1.5 cm hypoechoic nodule.
문맥 혈전 없음. 복수 없음. 비장비대 (13.5 cm).

결론:
1. New 1.5 cm hypoechoic nodule in S8, liver cirrhosis.

권고:
HCC 감별 위해 가능한 1개월 이내 liver dynamic MRI (gadoxetic acid) 권함.
rationale: AASLD / ACR LI-RADS: a new >=1 cm nodule on surveillance US in cirrhosis needs multiphase MRI; the radiologist's explicit 1-month MRI recommendation is R031.

title: Chest radiograph (PA)
text:
검사명: Chest PA
임상정보: 갑자기 발생한 좌측 흉통, 호흡곤란
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Lt. hemithorax에 visceral pleural line 보이며 apex에서 흉벽까지 약 3.5 cm 간격의 pneumothorax.
종격동 이동 없음. 우측 폐 정상.

결론:
Lt. pneumothorax, moderate (apex-cupola 3.5 cm), no tension.

※ 응급의학과 이OO 교수에게 14:05 구두 보고함.
rationale: ACR communication practice parameter: pneumothorax is a critical finding; the communication is documented in the report.

title: Chest radiograph (PA)
text:
검사명: Chest PA
임상정보: 신장이식 후 면역억제제 복용. 발열, 기침.
비교: 2025-11-02 Chest PA

판독소견:
RLL에 새로 생긴 patchy consolidation, air-bronchogram 동반.
소량의 우측 흉수. 심장 크기 정상.

결론:
RLL pneumonia with small Rt. pleural effusion.

권고:
치료 후 6주 뒤 Chest PA 추적검사로 resolution 확인 요망.
rationale: BTS / ACR actionable reporting: explicit recommendation for a repeat chest radiograph in 6 weeks to document resolution.

title: Chest CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT, enhanced
임상정보: 기침 2개월
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Rt. major fissure에 접한 7 mm 크기의 triangular (lentiform) solid nodule, smooth margin. 소엽간 중격과 연결되어 있음.
그 외 폐실질 특이소견 없음. 기관지 정상. 림프절 비대 없음.

결론:
Rt. 7 mm perifissural nodule, likely intrapulmonary lymph node.

권고:
전형적 perifissural nodule로 Fleischner 2017 기준 추적검사 불필요.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: a typical perifissural nodule, even >6 mm, needs no follow-up.

title: Chest CT (non-enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT
임상정보: 과거 결핵 병력, 객혈 1회
비교: 2023-04-12 Chest CT

판독소견:
RUL에 5 mm completely calcified nodule, 이전과 변화 없음 (calcified granuloma).
RUL posterior segment에 fibrotic band 및 경미한 기관지확장, 이전과 동일 (old TB).
활동성 병변 없음.

결론:
1. Old TB sequelae with calcified granuloma, stable.
2. No active lung lesion.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: a completely calcified nodule is benign and needs no follow-up.

title: Chest CT (non-enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT, non-enhanced
임상정보: 건강검진 Chest PA상 이상음영
비교: 없음

판독소견:
LUL apicoposterior segment에 8 mm pure ground-glass nodule. 고형성분 없음.
그 외 폐실질 특이소견 없음.
종격동 림프절 비대 없음.

결론:
LUL 8 mm pure GGN.

권고:
Fleischner 2017 기준 6-12개월 후 추적 CT로 지속 여부 확인, 지속 시 5년까지 2년 간격 추적 권함.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: single pure ground-glass nodule >=6 mm needs CT at 6-12 months to confirm persistence.

title: Chest CT (non-enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT, non-enhanced
임상정보: part-solid nodule 추적
비교: 2025-12-18 Chest CT

판독소견:
RUL anterior segment의 part-solid nodule, 전체 크기 14 mm, solid component 7 mm로 이전 (전체 14 mm, solid 7 mm) 대비 변화 없이 지속됨.
새로운 결절 없음. 림프절 비대 없음.

결론:
Persistent RUL part-solid nodule (total 14 mm, solid portion 7 mm) - adenocarcinoma spectrum 의심.

권고:
흉부외과/호흡기내과 협진 및 PET-CT 또는 조직검사 고려.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: a persistent part-solid nodule with solid component >=6 mm is highly suspicious and needs PET/CT, biopsy or resection.

title: Chest CT (non-enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT, non-enhanced
임상정보: 폐결절 추적관찰
비교: 2025-04-24 Chest CT

판독소견:
LLL superior segment의 solid nodule이 6.5 mm로 이전 (4.0 mm) 대비 증가함. 경계 약간 lobulated.
그 외 새로운 결절 없음.

결론:
LLL solid nodule, interval growth (4.0 -> 6.5 mm over 12 months).

권고:
성장하는 결절로 PET-CT 및 호흡기내과 협진 권함.
rationale: Fleischner 2017: a solid nodule that grows (here 2.5 mm in a year) is suspicious and needs further work-up.

title: Brain CT and CT perfusion
text:
검사명: Brain CT, CT angiography, CT perfusion (stroke protocol)
임상정보: LNT 1시간 전, Rt. hemiparesis, aphasia
비교: 없음

판독소견:
NCCT: Lt. MCA territory에 early ischemic change (insular ribbon sign), ASPECTS 8. 출혈 없음.
CTA: Lt. M1 segment occlusion.
CTP: Lt. MCA territory에 core 15 mL, penumbra 85 mL (mismatch ratio 6.7).

결론:
Acute Lt. MCA infarction due to Lt. M1 occlusion, large penumbra. 혈관내 치료 대상.

※ 신경과 박OO 선생님께 판독 즉시 (10:12) 전화 통보함.
rationale: ACR communication practice parameter: acute large-vessel occlusion stroke is a critical finding; the call is documented.

title: Abdomen-pelvis CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: APCT, enhanced
임상정보: 대장암으로 2일전 개복 저위전방절제술 (LAR) 시행. 발열.
비교: 2026-04-20 APCT (수술 전)

판독소견:
복강내 소량의 free air가 전복벽 아래에 있으며, 수술 직후 예상되는 범위의 postoperative pneumoperitoneum으로 판단됨.
문합부 주위 fluid collection이나 조영제 누출 없음.
소량의 골반강 복수. 장폐색 소견 없음.

결론:
1. Small amount of postoperative pneumoperitoneum, expected 2 days after laparotomy.
2. No evidence of anastomotic leakage or abscess.
rationale: A small amount of expected postoperative free air 2 days after laparotomy without leak is not an unexpected critical finding.

title: Neck CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: Neck CT, enhanced
임상정보: 경부 림프절 비대 촉지
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Level II 반응성으로 보이는 1.0 cm 미만 림프절 몇 개.
갑상선 우엽에 2.0 cm 크기의 저음영 결절, 석회화 없음. 주위 침윤 소견 없음.
그 외 특이소견 없음.

결론:
1. Reactive-looking Lt. level II lymph nodes.
2. Rt. thyroid 2.0 cm nodule.

권고:
갑상선 초음파 권함.
rationale: ACR thyroid incidental white paper: an incidental thyroid nodule >=1.5 cm in a patient >=35 needs thyroid ultrasound.

title: Chest CT (enhanced)
text:
검사명: Chest CT, enhanced
임상정보: 교통사고 후 흉부 외상 평가
비교: 없음

판독소견:
늑골 골절이나 기흉, 혈흉 없음. 폐좌상 없음.
종격동 혈종 없음. 대동맥 정상.
촬영 범위에 포함된 갑상선 좌엽에 1.2 cm 저음영 결절.

결론:
1. No traumatic injury in the chest.
2. Lt. thyroid 1.2 cm incidental nodule.

권고:
임상적으로 판단하여 갑상선 초음파 고려.
rationale: ACR thyroid incidental white paper: in patients <35 years, an incidental thyroid nodule >=1 cm warrants thyroid ultrasound.

title: Whole-body PET-CT
text:
검사명: F-18 FDG PET-CT (torso)
임상정보: 대장암 수술 후 1년, 재발 평가
비교: 2025-05-02 PET-CT

판독소견:
문합부 및 복강 내 비정상 FDG 섭취 없음. 간, 폐 전이 소견 없음.
갑상선 우엽에 새로운 국소적 FDG 섭취 (SUVmax 7.4), CT상 1.3 cm 저음영 결절.

결론:
1. No evidence of recurrent colorectal cancer.
2. New focal FDG uptake in Rt. thyroid lobe - 갑상선 초음파 및 필요 시 FNA 권함.
rationale: ACR thyroid incidental white paper: any focal FDG-avid thyroid nodule needs thyroid ultrasound.

title: Low-dose chest CT for lung cancer screening (addendum)
text:
검사명: LDCT (폐암검진)
임상정보: 폐암검진 baseline, 현재흡연 35 PY
비교: 없음

판독소견:
Rt. minor fissure에 접한 mean diameter 9.0 mm solid nodule.

결론:
Lung-RADS 4A. 3개월 후 LDCT 권함.

[추가판독 2026-05-14]
재검토 결과 해당 결절은 Rt. minor fissure에 접한 triangular shape, smooth margin의 perifissural nodule (mean diameter 9.0 mm < 10 mm)로 전형적인 intrapulmonary lymph node 소견임.
Lung-RADS v2022 기준 category 2로 정정함.
정정 결론: Lung-RADS 2. 12개월 후 정기 LDCT 검진. 3개월 LDCT 불필요.
rationale: Lung-RADS v2022: juxtapleural/perifissural solid nodule <10 mm with benign features is category 2; the addendum withdraws the 4A recommendation.

title: Kidney CT (dynamic)
text:
검사명: Kidney CT (unenhanced, corticomedullary, nephrographic, excretory)
임상정보: 건강검진 초음파상 Rt. renal complex cyst
비교: 2026-04-28 Abdomen US

판독소견:
Rt. kidney interpolar region에 3.4 cm 크기의 cystic mass, 두꺼운 불규칙 벽 및 9 mm 크기의 enhancing nodular component (unenhanced 28 HU -> nephrographic 96 HU).
신정맥 혈전 없음. 주변 림프절 비대 없음.

비뇨의학과 협진 요망.
rationale: Bosniak v2019: class IV cystic mass (enhancing nodule) is likely malignant and needs urology referral.

text:

CLINICAL HISTORY: Long-segment Barrett's esophagus.

  Barrett's esophagus (columnar mucosa with goblet cells) with HIGH-GRADE DYSPLASIA, focal (1 of 8 fragments).

COMMENT: Diagnosis confirmed by a second gastrointestinal pathologist. Endoscopic eradication therapy evaluation is recommended.
rationale: High-grade dysplasia in Barrett's esophagus requires notification and referral for endoscopic eradication therapy.

rationale: Benign prostate biopsy without carcinoma or atypia does not trigger abnormal-pathology notification or referral.
